programme.title: Ace in the Hole
programme.desc: A cave collapse traps a man, and all eyes turn toward the tragedy, including those of Charles "Chuck" Tatum (Kirk Douglas), a washed-up newspaper reporter who sees the incident as a ticket back to his former days at the top of the journalism heap.

programme.title: Paths Of Glory
programme.desc: This powerful, fact-based absurdity-of-war film stars Kirk Douglas as a commanding officer who defends three scapegoats on trial for a failed offensive that occurred within the French Army in 1916.

programme.title: Detective Story
programme.desc: Kirk Douglas stars as the rigid detective whose personal code has become twisted from dealing with too many criminals. Eleanor Parker is his wife, tormented by a guilty secret.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back and gain the freedom of his people in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Troy
programme.desc: Throughout time, men have waged war. Some for power, some for glory, some for honor ... and some for love.

programme.title: Fight Club
programme.desc: A detached man and his friend organize brutal, bare-knuckle boxing matches.

programme.title: Carrie (2002)
programme.desc: Angela Bettis stars in this adaptation of Stephen King's classic tale of horror. Carrie White has been cursed with the power of telekinesis and when her tormenters commit an act of unforgivable humiliation, they'll soon learn a deadly lesson.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: When four teenagers all meet with mysterious deaths exactly one week after watching a videotape, investigative reporter Rachel Keller tracks down the video... and watches it.

programme.title: Hush
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray and his adopted son, Quick, run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Gangster Bugsy Calhoune pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone to close Club Sugar Ray down.

programme.title: Coming to America
programme.desc: Join EDDIE MURPHY on an unforgettable comic quest to the New World. As an African Prince, it's time for him to find a princess. The mission leads him and his most loyal friend (ARSENIO HALL) to New York. Watch Murphy and Hall in classic cameo roles!

programme.title: The Golden Child
programme.desc: As ‘The Chosen One’, Murphy’s on a madcap mission to save The Golden Child, a youth with mystical powers who’s been abducted by an evil cult.

programme.title: Martial Law
programme.desc: Sean Thompson and Billie Blake are a part of the L.A.P.D.'s new program called 'Martial Law'. When they begin to tangle with criminal and kung fu master Dalton Rhodes, it becomes personal...

programme.title: Martial Law II: Undercover
programme.desc: Two undercover cops investigating a murder uncover a deadly ring of corruption at a nightclub where the rich are entertained by seductive women and protected by martial arts experts.

programme.title: Cyborg
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi thriller as Gibson Rickenbacker, the future's most fearsome warrior. In the wake of a plague, Rickenbacker must rescue the only person who can develop a vaccine and save civilization.

programme.title: Death Warrant
programme.desc: Action superstar Jean-Claude van Damme ("Bloodsport", "Cyborg") is a veteran undercover cop posing as an inmate in a dangerously corrupt state prison.

programme.title: Wayne's World 2
programme.desc: Having achieved godlike status as a late-night TV personality, Wayne now confronts the question that has plagued man for centuries: Is there life after cable?

programme.title: The Ladies Man (2000)
programme.desc: Leon loses his radio show because of his X-rated on-air comments. He then gets a letter from a former flame promising him a lifetime of wealth and happiness, and things start looking up!

programme.title: A Night at the Roxbury
programme.desc: It seems like Steve and Doug will never be cool enough to make the Roxbury club’s guest list. Until they have a fender bender with their role model, club regular Richard Grieco. Eager to avoid litigation, Grieco befriends the starstruck pair.

programme.title: Superstar
programme.desc: All Mary Katherine Gallagher wants in life is a kiss. Not just any kiss, mind you – a Hollywood-style kiss. But no matter how hard she tries, no one will kiss her. She decides that to get her kiss, she must become just like the people in the movies.

programme.title: Girl Most Likely
programme.desc: Kristen Wiig stars in this sweet and funny movie about a failed playwright who is forced to move home with her eccentric mother (Annette Bening).

programme.title: Chef
programme.desc: Chef quits his job in LA after refusing to compromise with its owner; he is left to figure out what's next. He teams up with his ex, a friend & his son to launch a food truck, reigniting his passion for the kitchen and zest for life.

programme.title: New Year's Eve
programme.desc: Set in New York on New Year's Eve, this romantic comedy celebrates love, hope, forgiveness, second chances, and fresh starts through the intertwining stories of couples and singles, told amid the pulse and promise of the most dazzling night of the year.

programme.title: Crimson Tide
programme.desc: The USS Alabama receives an unconfirmed order to launch its missiles.

programme.title: Déjà Vu
programme.desc: If you thought it was just a trick of the mind, prepare yourself for the truth.

programme.title: Body of Lies
programme.desc: Leonardo Di Caprio and Academy Award winner Russell Crowe star in director Ridley Scott's adaptation of the best-selling post-9/11 espionage thriller.

programme.title: Man on Fire (2004)
programme.desc: A Marine swears vengeance on those who committed an act against the family he was hired to protect.

programme.title: The Patriot
programme.desc: In 1776, South Carolina widower and legendary war hero Benjamin Martin (Mel Gibson) finds himself thrust into the midst of the American Revolutionary War as he helplessly watches his family torn apart by the savage British Redcoats.

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Clint Eastwood and Academy Award-winner Steven Spielberg comes the life stories of the six men who raised the flag at The Battle of Iwo Jima, a turning point in WWII.

programme.title: Any Given Sunday
programme.desc: Academy Award winner Al Pacino and Cameron Diaz lead a stellar cast in Oscar-winning Oliver Stone's hard-hitting homage to the gridiron gladiators of Any Given Sunday.

programme.title: Renegade
programme.desc: Mattie, a young lady living in a mine camp of the Southwest, unwittingly marries a claim jumper despite the fact she is in love with a gold miner. Soon, the Old West brings her death, confusion and the hard reality of her claim jumping husband.

programme.title: Billy the Kid
programme.desc: When a bounty hunter kills a member of an outlaw gang, all Hell breaks loose in this shoot-‘em-up tale of gun smoke and justice in the Old West.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

programme.title: GoodFellas
programme.desc: Director Martin Scorsese exposes the fascinating, mysterious, and violent underworld of New York's Mafia families through the life of insider Henry Hill.

programme.title: Bringing Out the Dead
programme.desc: Frank Pierce, a paramedic, is on the brink of madness from too many years of saving and losing lives. One fateful night, Frank meets Mary Burke, the daughter of a man Frank tried to save. Together, Frank and Mary confront the ghosts of the past.

programme.title: Gangs Of New York
programme.desc: Martin Scorsese's epic film set in mid-19th century Lower Manhattan tells the story of a young Irish immigrant (Leonardo DiCaprio) seeking revenge against the rival gang leader who killed his father.

programme.title: The Barrens
programme.desc: A weekend getaway turns murderous at the Wharton State Pine Barrens, as a family starts to believe they’ve encountered the legendary Jersey Devil. Starring Stephen Moyer (TV’s TRUE BLOOD).

programme.title: Hell House LLC.
programme.desc: Five years after an unexplained malfunction causes the death of 15 tour-goers and staff on the opening night of a Halloween haunted house tour, a documentary crew travels back to the scene of the tragedy to find out what really happened.

programme.title: Texas Chainsaw Massacre 3D
programme.desc: A young woman inherits an isolated mansion from a distant relative, but an unspeakable horror awaits her in the mansion's dank cellars.

programme.title: The Goonies
programme.desc: With brothers Mikey and Brand's house slated for demolition by greedy developers, the boys' only hope lies in finding a long-lost treasure. They uncover a treasure map and, with their friends, descend to a subterranean sea and an abandoned galleon.

programme.title: Poltergeist
programme.desc: At first, the spirits that invade the Freelings' home seem like playful children. But then they turn angry. And when 10-year-old Carol Anne is pulled from this world into another, Steve and Diane Freeling turn to an exorcist.

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: A single mother and her two sons discover much more than they anticipated in this visually stunning blend of hip humor, horror, and rock 'n' roll about the most compelling group of contemporary vampires ever to put fang to vein.

programme.title: Dirty Dancing
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey star in this spirit-lifting story about a summer love affair between a naïve 17-year-old girl and a charismatic dance instructor at a Catskills hotel. Rated PG-13

programme.title: The Time Machine
programme.desc: Hoping to alter the events of the past, a 19th-century inventor instead travels 800,000 years into the future, where he finds humankind divided into two warring races.

programme.title: D.A.R.Y.L.
programme.desc: A young boy is found wandering, with no memory of who he is. A family takes him in and begins to look for clues to help him find his way home.

programme.title: Clue
programme.desc: Meet all the notorious suspects and discover their foul playthings. You'll love their dastardly doings as the bodies and the laughs pile up before your eyes. Featuring all three surprise endings!!

programme.title: Reservoir Dogs
programme.desc: After a seemingly perfectly planned robbery goes awry, a group of criminals begins to suspect a traitor in their ranks, and back at their headquarters, they try to suss out the culprit.

programme.title: Jackie Brown
programme.desc: A female flight attendant becomes a key figure in a plot between the police and an arms dealer.

programme.title: Heist
programme.desc: A jewel thief's nephew is sent along on a heist to ensure a longtime partner in crime stays honest about the division of the loot.

programme.title: Burlesque
programme.desc: A small-town singer moves to the big city for her chance at stardom when she discovers Burlesque, a glamorous nightclub packed with dancers, sizzling musical numbers, and an owner in need of a star.

programme.title: Jerry Maguire
programme.desc: Jerry Maguire is a sports agent who reaches a crisis point in his life when he decides to become an honorable man. Follow his journey to redemption through an unlikely alliance with a female accountant, and his least important client.

programme.title: Fargo
programme.desc: Things go awry when car salesman Jerry Lundegaard (William H. Macy) hires two thugs to kidnap his wife. Soon, the very pregnant and chipper Police Chief Marge Gunderson (Frances McDormand) takes the case. Is she up for the challenge? You betcha.

programme.title: Sense and Sensibility
programme.desc: Emma Thompson stars in the captivating romance based on Jane Austen's classic novel of two sisters' search for love in strict Victorian society.

programme.title: Sleepless in Seattle
programme.desc: Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan star in an enchanting romance about a widower whose son convinces him to find new love and the woman who answers his call.

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Multiple Academy Award winner Tom Hanks reunites with his Sleepless in Seattle co-star, Meg Ryan, and director Nora Ephron, to discover love at first byte in this online romantic comedy.

programme.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
programme.desc: This dazzling remake of the 1956 spine-tingler stars Donald Sutherland, Brooke Adams, Jeff Goldblum, Leonard Nimoy and Veronica Cartwright in an eerie tale of possession by "alien pods."

programme.title: The Warriors
programme.desc: The armies of the night number 100,000; they outnumber the police 5 to 1; and tonight they're after the Warriors.

programme.title: The Little Girl Who Lives Down The Lane
programme.desc: Jodie Foster and Martin Sheen star in this haunting story of a thirteen-year-old girl who lives in an old house with her reclusive father...all alone. Or does she? It seems she is hiding a dark secret, one she is determined to preserve. At any cost!

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: The non-human machine ruling elite of the nuclear war-torn future has dispatched a cyborg assassin into the past to kill a young boy because he soon will be the resistance leader against the machines.

programme.title: Terminator Genisys
programme.desc: When John Connor sends Kyle Reese back to 1984 to protect a young Sarah Connor, unexpected events alter the past and threaten the future of all mankind. Charged with a new mission, Reese must join forces with Sarah and her "Guardian" to save the world.

programme.title: Blade Runner: The Final Cut
programme.desc: Harrison Ford stars in this fascinating, dark vision of the near future as a policeman who tracks engineered humans — a Blade Runner.

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: Harrison Ford reprises his iconic role as a relentless blade runner hunting down escaped replicants in a dystopian 21st-century Los Angeles.

programme.title: Ghosts of Girlfriends Past
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey stars with Jennifer Garner in this romantic comedy about a committed bachelor who gets a wake-up call from his late, legendary, hard-partying Uncle Wayne and his own Ghosts of Girlfriends Past.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: A high-school boy is given the chance to write a story for Rolling Stone Magazine about an up-and-coming rock band as he accompanies it on their concert tour.

programme.title: Role Models
programme.desc: The world's least likely mentors must set aside their selfish ways to impart invaluable wisdom to two kids about life, love, and heavy metal.

programme.title: Miller's Girl
programme.desc: A creative writing assignment yields complex results between a teacher and his talented student.

programme.title: Alice, Darling
programme.desc: Pushed to the breaking point, a woman enjoys some much-needed time away from her psychologically abusive boyfriend. However, when his vengeance is unleashed, it tests her strength, her courage, and the bonds of deep-rooted friendships.

programme.title: Into the Deep
programme.desc: A woman's whirlwind romance with a handsome stranger soon turns into a web of deceit, mistrust and violence aboard his yacht.

programme.title: Mrs. Doubtfire
programme.desc: An eccentric dad dresses as a British nanny to care for his kids at their mother's home.

programme.title: Good Will Hunting
programme.desc: The hit Oscar-winning drama, which launched the careers of Matt Damon and Ben Affleck, tells the tale of a headstrong, working-class genius who's failing the lessons of life until he meets a relatable psychology professor (Robin Williams).

programme.title: Popeye
programme.desc: The legendary, beloved anvil-armed sailor of the seven seas comes magically to life in this delightful musical, starring Robin Williams as Popeye, who meets all challenges with the unshakable philosophy, "I yam what I yam and that's all that I yam."

programme.title: Mrs. Doubtfire
programme.desc: An eccentric dad dresses as a British nanny to care for his kids at their mother's home.

programme.title: All Dirt Roads Taste of Salt
programme.desc: A richly layered ode to the generations of people and places that shape us in a lyrical, decades-spanning exploration of a woman's life in Mississippi. The haunting feature debut from award-winning artist Raven Jackson.

programme.title: Earth Mama
programme.desc: With two children in foster care, Gia, a pregnant single mother pitted against the system, fights to reclaim her family. In her close-knit Bay Area community, she works to make a life for herself and her kids.

programme.title: Moonlight

programme.title: Houseboat
programme.desc: This Oscar®-nominated film has the legendary Cary Grant as a government attorney who can't seem to shake his bad fortune. Living on a houseboat, widowed and left with three unruly kids, he hires Sophia Loren as a governess.

programme.title: Fight Club
programme.desc: A detached man and his friend organize brutal, bare-knuckle boxing matches.

programme.title: Inglourious Basterds (2009)
programme.desc: An American officer is in charge of an all-Jewish squad known as The Basterds and is tasked with the mission of killing as many Nazi troops as possible.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: A diamond heist gone haywire launches gangsters, bookies, and a dog on a rollicking ride through the rugged world of bare-knuckle boxing in search of the missing stone—a critically acclaimed comedy from Guy Ritchie.

programme.title: Sleepwalker
programme.desc: Haunted by terrifying visions, Sarah's sleepwalking episodes begin to intensify, accelerating her descent into darkness.

programme.title: Diabolic
programme.desc: A woman must return to the fundamentalist compound where she was raised after the vengeful spirit of a cursed witch haunts her.

programme.title: Rosario
programme.desc: Trapped by a snowstorm with her estranged grandmother's corpse, Rosario (Emeraude Toubia) faces terrifying supernatural forces and a deadly family curse.

programme.title: Norbit
programme.desc: Murphy stars as mild-mannered Norbit, who gets a second chance at love with his childhood sweetheart, Kate. However, obstacles may make this romance slightly more difficult than expected.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea Goes to Jail
programme.desc: At long last, Madea returns to the big screen! This time, America's favorite irreverent, pistol-packin' grandmomma is raising hell behind bars and lobbying for her freedom.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Family Reunion
programme.desc: A pistol-packing grandma tries to hold a family reunion, a funeral, and a wedding all in the same weekend.

programme.title: Double Team
programme.desc: Action superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme joins forces with NBA and media sensation Dennis Rodman in this action-packed thriller. Top counter-terrorist Jack Quinn is ready to get out of the spy game until the evil Stavros kidnaps his wife and unborn son.

programme.title: Double Dragon
programme.desc: Evil meets its match in this daring martial arts adventure about two teen brothers out to stop an obsessed tycoon from finding both halves of a mystical talisman.

programme.title: Street Fighter II: The Animated Movie
programme.desc: Based on the legendary video game series. This anime classic follows Ryu, a talented fighter who may be the greatest in all of the world, and Bison, the evil mastermind searching for Ryu's talents.

programme.title: Wayne's World
programme.desc: When a sleazy TV exec offers Wayne and Garth a contract to tape their late-night cable-access show at his network, they discover the road to the big time is full of gnarly twists and turns.

programme.title: Wayne's World 2
programme.desc: Having achieved godlike status as a late-night TV personality, Wayne now confronts the question that has plagued man for centuries: Is there life after cable?

programme.title: Canadian Bacon
programme.desc: Falling approval ratings and a sagging economy, cause a desperate U.S. president to turn America against its most unlikely enemy, Canada. A Niagara Falls sheriff and his band of misfit deputies invade Canada leaving the President's plans in shambles.

programme.title: The Notebook
programme.desc: In a tale of love lost and found again, two ordinary people are rendered extraordinary by the strength, power, and beauty of true love.

programme.title: Dirty Dancing
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey star in this spirit-lifting story about a summer love affair between a naïve 17-year-old girl and a charismatic dance instructor at a Catskills hotel. Rated PG-13

programme.title: Titanic
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio and Oscar-nominee Kate Winslet light up the screen as Jack and Rose, the young lovers who find one another on the maiden voyage of the "unsinkable" R.M.S. Titanic.

programme.title: Chef
programme.desc: Chef quits his job in LA after refusing to compromise with its owner; he is left to figure out what's next. He teams up with his ex, a friend & his son to launch a food truck, reigniting his passion for the kitchen and zest for life.

programme.title: Man on Fire (2004)
programme.desc: A Marine swears vengeance on those who committed an act against the family he was hired to protect.

programme.title: Crimson Tide
programme.desc: The USS Alabama receives an unconfirmed order to launch its missiles.

programme.title: Déjà Vu
programme.desc: If you thought it was just a trick of the mind, prepare yourself for the truth.

programme.title: Any Given Sunday
programme.desc: Academy Award winner Al Pacino and Cameron Diaz lead a stellar cast in Oscar-winning Oliver Stone's hard-hitting homage to the gridiron gladiators of Any Given Sunday.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: Dances With Wolves
programme.desc: After encountering and eventually being accepted by a Native American tribe, Dunbar's loyalties are put to the test when the army threatens his new home, forcing him to choose between white America or the natives he now calls his people.

programme.title: Geronimo: An American Legend
programme.desc: An American legend comes to life in this epic Western, starring Jason Patric, Robert Duvall, Gene Hackman, and Wes Studi as Geronimo, who delivers a stunning performance as the fearless warrior who was the last Indian leader to surrender to the white man.

programme.title: The Quick and the Dead
programme.desc: In this edgy and darkly humorous Western, a mysterious young woman rides into the lawless town of Redemption to settle an old score that has haunted her since childhood. She becomes swept up in a deadly quick-draw tournament. Rated: R

programme.title: Small Soldiers
programme.desc: Joe Dante directed this satirical action-comedy about talking tech toys accidentally juiced-up with military microchips.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (2014)
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Gangs Of New York

programme.title: The Aviator

programme.title: Shutter Island

programme.title: April Fool's Day
programme.desc: When Muffy St. John invited her college friends up to her parents’ secluded island home for the time of their lives, she just forgot to tell them it might be the last time of their lives.

programme.title: Hellraiser

programme.title: Hellraiser II: Hellbound
programme.desc: Kirsty is brought to an institution after the horrible events of Hellraiser (1987), where the occult-obsessive head doctor resurrects Julia and unleashes the Cenobites and their demonic underworld.

programme.title: Footloose

programme.title: St. Elmo's Fire

programme.title: Next of Kin

programme.title: Grease 2

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: A star bowler whose career was prematurely "cut off" hopes to ride a new prodigy to success and riches.

programme.title: Clue
programme.desc: Meet all the notorious suspects and discover their foul playthings. You'll love their dastardly doings as the bodies and the laughs pile up before your eyes. Featuring all three surprise endings!!

programme.title: The Score
programme.desc: When safecracker Nick decides it's time to settle down with his girlfriend Diane and stick to his legitimate business, running a jazz nightclub, his friend and partner Max has other plans.

programme.title: American Hustle
programme.desc: The con is on when scam artists and lovers Irving Rosenfeld and Sydney Prosser are entrapped by ambitious FBI agent Richie DiMaso and coerced into participating in a sting operation that hinges on snaring politician Carmine Polito and his associates.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America, along with the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: Winners of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which the irresistible stolen loot from a crime scene sets off an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: Inside Llewyn Davis
programme.desc: Inside Llewyn Davis follows a young folk singer as he navigates the Greenwich Village folk scene of 1961. Llewyn Davis (Oscar Isaac) is struggling to make it as a musician against seemling insurmountable obstacles - some of them of his own making.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: City Slickers
programme.desc: Billy Crystal and Jack Palance ride the range as a middle-aged urban SUV jockey and a hardened and weathered cowpoke in this Western tale of a cattle drive that becomes a journey of self-discovery for a band of City Slickers.

programme.title: Grumpy Old Men
programme.desc: Jack Lemmon and Walter Matthau portray lifelong feuding neighbors making each day a hilarious game of revenge. But then voluptuous Ariel moves in nearby, and their dormant hormones reignite in an all-out competition to win her favor.

programme.title: Grumpier Old Men
programme.desc: In this sequel to Grumpy Old Men, a vivacious Italian beauty attempts to convert Wabasha, Minnesota's cherished bait store, into a romantic Italian restaurant.

programme.title: The Amityville Horror (1979)
programme.desc: Supposed true story about the Lutzm family whose dream house turns into a nightmare. The unsuspecting new tenants of a house whose previous occupants had been murdered in their sleep.

programme.title: The Warriors
programme.desc: The armies of the night number 100,000; they outnumber the police 5 to 1; and tonight they're after the Warriors.

programme.title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: 40th Anniversary
programme.desc: Five youths on a weekend getaway fall prey to a depraved family of cannibals in Tobe Hooper's masterpiece of subversive horror, now featuring a 4k digital transfer and all-new surround sound mix supervised by the director.

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: Harrison Ford reprises his iconic role as a relentless blade runner hunting down escaped replicants in a dystopian 21st-century Los Angeles.

programme.title: Ex Machina
programme.desc: A young programmer (Domhnall Gleeson) at an internet company is chosen by a reclusive CEO (Oscar Isaac) to evaluate the capabilities and consciousness of a beautiful and sophisticated robot (Alicia Vikander).

programme.title: Robocop
programme.desc: Detroit in the near future. A cop who dies in the line of duty is transformed into a crime-fighting cyborg by the corporation which now runs the police department. The only hitch: this "perfect" cop still seeks revenge on the creeps who mutilated him.

programme.title: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants
programme.desc: Meet Tibby, Bridget, Lena and Carmen—four teenage best friends who share a pair of secondhand jeans as a unique way of staying connected while separated during a pivotal point in their lives—the summer of their 16th birthdays.

programme.title: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants 2
programme.desc: With unraveled embroidery and fraying hems, the pants are back for another glorious summer that four now college-aged friends will never forget.

programme.title: Role Models
programme.desc: The world's least likely mentors must set aside their selfish ways to impart invaluable wisdom to two kids about life, love, and heavy metal.

programme.title: Killers
programme.desc: A woman's perfect suburban life explodes in a hail of bullets when she learns that her husband is an international superspy.

programme.title: The Spy Who Dumped Me
programme.desc: Unexpectedly thrust into an international conspiracy, two best friends find themselves dodging deadly assassins and a suspicious British agent while hatching a plan to save the world.

programme.title: Miller's Girl
programme.desc: A creative writing assignment yields complex results between a teacher and his talented student.

programme.title: Mrs. Doubtfire
programme.desc: An eccentric dad dresses as a British nanny to care for his kids at their mother's home.

programme.title: Good Will Hunting

programme.title: Cadillac Man

programme.title: The Devil Inside
programme.desc: In 1989 Maria Rossi was diagnosed insane after brutally murdering three people. Twenty years later, her daughter Isabella searches for answers that lead to an exorcism of her mother.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: When four teenagers all meet with mysterious deaths exactly one week after watching a videotape, investigative reporter Rachel Keller tracks down the video... and watches it.

programme.title: Goodnight Mommy
programme.desc: In the heat of the summer. A lonesome house in the countryside between woods and cornfields. Nine-year-old twin brothers are waiting for their mother.

programme.title: Norbit
programme.desc: Murphy stars as mild-mannered Norbit, who gets a second chance at love with his childhood sweetheart, Kate. However, obstacles may make this romance slightly more difficult than expected.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea Goes to Jail
programme.desc: At long last, Madea returns to the big screen! This time, America's favorite irreverent, pistol-packin' grandmomma is raising hell behind bars and lobbying for her freedom.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Family Reunion
programme.desc: A pistol-packing grandma tries to hold a family reunion, a funeral, and a wedding all in the same weekend.

programme.title: Tekken: Kazuya's Revenge
programme.desc: A defenseless man is kidnapped by an organized crime syndicate and turned into a ruthless assassin.

programme.title: Lady Bloodfight
programme.desc: Upon arriving in Hong Kong, an American woman is beaten up and mugged by thugs. She's taken in by a martial arts master who trains her for a formidable fight competition known as the Kumite.

programme.title: Bloodsport
programme.desc: Ninjitsu master Frank Dux journeys to Hong Kong to enter the Kumite, the Olympics of martial arts, and meets a beautiful American reporter. Before long he must face Chong-Li, a vicious Korean master of Tae Kwan Do, in a climactic fight to the finish.

programme.title: Planes, Trains & Automobiles
programme.desc: Neal just wants to fly home to Chicago for Thanksgiving with his family. But all he gets is misery. Misery named Del Griffith, a loud-mouthed salesman who leads Neal on a wild goose chase.

programme.title: Armed and Dangerous (1986)
programme.desc: John Candy and Eugene Levy charge into the world of private security in the outrageous action-comedy ARMED AND DANGEROUS. Unfortunately, they're usually charging in the wrong direction! Rating: PG-13

programme.title: The Nutty Professor (1996)
programme.desc: Eddie Murphy gives "the performances" of his career -- playing seven roles! -- in this hilarious comedy about a genetics professor who experiments with his own fat-reducing serum.

programme.title: Chef
programme.desc: Chef quits his job in LA after refusing to compromise with its owner; he is left to figure out what's next. He teams up with his ex, a friend & his son to launch a food truck, reigniting his passion for the kitchen and zest for life.

programme.title: Father of the Bride
programme.desc: Steve Martin turns in a heartwarming and hilarious performance.

programme.title: The Bounty Hunter (2010)
programme.desc: Milo is a bounty hunter who gets his dream job when he is assigned to track down his bail-jumping reporter ex-wife. When she gives him the slip so she can chase a lead on a murder cover-up, Milo realizes that nothing ever goes smoothly with her.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: Thunderheart
programme.desc: Val Kilmer, Sam Shepard, and Graham Greene star in this murder mystery filled with style and suspense. Kilmer stars as Ray Levoi, a hotshot FBI agent who's thrust into a strange new world when he is sent to solve a murder on an Indian reservation.

programme.title: Vertical Limit
programme.desc: An emotionally charged action-adventure tale of a retired climber (O'Donnell) who must launch a treacherous and extraordinary rescue effort up K2, the world's second-highest peak, to save his estranged sister and her summit team in a race against time.

programme.title: Remember
programme.desc: Everything is not what it seems in this riveting revenge thriller, where a relentless man will stop at nothing to find and kill the Nazi officer who murdered his family 70 years earlier in WWII.

programme.title: A Soldier's Story
programme.desc: A fine drama set during World War II, in which a black military attorney investigates the death of a black sergeant. The lawyer eventually discovers that the sergeant was both ashamed of his own culture and virulently hated by his men.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Winner of 2 Academy Awards, including Best Original Screenplay. With the help of his mentor, a slave-turned-bounty hunter sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal plantation owner.

programme.title: The Hateful Eight
programme.desc: Quentin Tarantino’s 8th film takes place in wintry Wyoming, where eight strangers, including two bounty hunters and a wanted fugitive, find themselves battling the elements and each other.

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

programme.title: Small Soldiers
programme.desc: Joe Dante directed this satirical action-comedy about talking tech toys accidentally juiced-up with military microchips.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (2014)
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Sex. Money. Power. Drugs. Brace yourself for a true story from legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese. Leonardo DiCaprio stars as a young stockbroker hungry for a life of non-stop thrills, where corruption was king and more was never enough.

programme.title: GoodFellas
programme.desc: Director Martin Scorsese exposes the fascinating, mysterious, and violent underworld of New York's Mafia families through the life of insider Henry Hill.

programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five friends are holed up in a remote cabin, where they discover a Book Of The Dead. They unwittingly summon demons living in the nearby woods, which in turn possess the youngsters until only one remains intact to fight for survival.

programme.title: The Haunting
programme.desc: In this edge-of-your-seat supernatural thriller featuring Hollywood's hottest stars, a study in fear escalates into a heart-stopping nightmare for a professor and three subjects trapped in a mysterious mansion.

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
programme.desc: Master of horror Wes Craven presents a sexy, modern-day adaptation of the classic Gothic thriller. After Dracula is awakened from his 100-year slumber, he makes America his first destination, specifically the exotic city of New Orleans.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and, therefore, all youthful joy have been banned.

programme.title: St. Elmo's Fire
programme.desc: Seven friends, recent college graduates, are searching for a place in the real world as they face issues of career and commitment. Rating: R

programme.title: Next of Kin
programme.desc: When the mob murders policeman Truman Gates' younger brother, Gates is torn between his desire to uphold the law and his lust for revenge. But Gates' older brother will not be satisfied until every member of the Chicago mob is dead.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin' Rydell High for a whole new term! It's 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there's a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: A star bowler whose career was prematurely "cut off" hopes to ride a new prodigy to success and riches.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America, along with the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: Winners of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which the irresistible stolen loot from a crime scene sets off an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: Inside Llewyn Davis
programme.desc: Inside Llewyn Davis follows a young folk singer as he navigates the Greenwich Village folk scene of 1961. Llewyn Davis (Oscar Isaac) is struggling to make it as a musician against seemling insurmountable obstacles - some of them of his own making.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: Winners of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which the irresistible stolen loot from a crime scene sets off an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Multiple Academy Award winner Tom Hanks reunites with his Sleepless in Seattle co-star, Meg Ryan, and director Nora Ephron, to discover love at first byte in this online romantic comedy.

programme.title: City Slickers
programme.desc: Billy Crystal and Jack Palance ride the range as a middle-aged urban SUV jockey and a hardened and weathered cowpoke in this Western tale of a cattle drive that becomes a journey of self-discovery for a band of City Slickers.

programme.title: The First Wives Club
programme.desc: Join the Club - The First Wives Club, the good-time battle-of-the-sexes satire sparked by snappy one-liners, great physical-comedy gags, and three unforgettable stars in top form, Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, and Diane Keaton.

programme.title: The Exorcist
programme.desc: When a charming 12-year-old girl takes on the characteristics and voices of others, the girl's mother realizes the devil has possessed her daughter—and that her daughter's only hope lies with two priests and the ancient rite of demonic exorcism.

programme.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
programme.desc: This dazzling remake of the 1956 spine-tingler stars Donald Sutherland, Brooke Adams, Jeff Goldblum, Leonard Nimoy and Veronica Cartwright in an eerie tale of possession by "alien pods."

programme.title: Futureworld
programme.desc: An amusement park of the future caters to any adult fantasy. Lifelike androids carry out your every whim. A fun place, right? Not so, as a reporter and his Girl Friday find out while on a press junket to the newly opened Futureworld...

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: The non-human machine ruling elite of the nuclear war-torn future has dispatched a cyborg assassin into the past to kill a young boy because he soon will be the resistance leader against the machines.

programme.title: Terminator Genisys
programme.desc: When John Connor sends Kyle Reese back to 1984 to protect a young Sarah Connor, unexpected events alter the past and threaten the future of all mankind. Charged with a new mission, Reese must join forces with Sarah and her "Guardian" to save the world.

programme.title: Hellboy (2004)
programme.desc: Born in the flames of hell and brought to Earth, Hellboy was rescued from sinister forces by the benevolent Dr. Broom, who raised him to be a hero. Hellboy stands as the key line of defense against an evil madman who seeks to destroy mankind.

programme.title: Rachel Getting Married
programme.desc: When Kym returns to the Buchman family home for her sister Rachel's wedding, she brings a long history of personal crises, family conflict, and tragedy. Rated -R

programme.title: The Other Boleyn Girl
programme.desc: Two sisters, Anne and Mary, are driven by their ambitious family to seduce the king of England to advance their position at court. Rating: PG-13

programme.title: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants

programme.desc: Sydney si riunisce con una vecchia fiamma per rintracciare l'idolo della fertilità.

programme.title: Relic Hunter
programme.desc: Da un amico recentemente deceduto, Sydney riceve un mazzo di rari tarocchi.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Con Lily lontana, Nina e Costa sono in crisi. Un’amica medico nasconde una grave malattia. Proust sfida un paziente ossessionato dal cuore “monitorato” da un chip. Costa decide di partire per la Grecia.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Proust rischia il posto. Nina convince Smireni a riaprire l’ambulatorio del dolore. Un ragazzo cieco riacquista la vista ma fatica ad accettarlo. Léo ritrova Maud mentre in reparto nascono nuove alleanze.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Nina inaugura l’ambulatorio del dolore e si avvicina a Smireni. Proust cura un uomo in crisi e aiuta una famiglia a ricomporsi. Léo vive un nuovo amore, ma l’equilibrio resta fragile.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Una coppia tenta il suicidio dopo il fallimento del ristorante. Kevin e Aurélia affrontano un paziente che inventa ricordi. Nina scopre un segreto sull’eredità del padre: Smireni potrebbe essere suo fratello.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Nina aiuta una turista giapponese delusa dall’amore. Léo segue un detenuto che vuole riconciliarsi con la figlia. Smireni teme una ricaduta per Steve. Nina e Marc si avvicinano sempre più.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: L'intuito del neocommissario Roberto non sbaglia: dietro la morte apparentemente casuale della modella Eva Paulin si nasconde qualcosa di piu'. La giovane, con la complicita' del fratello Milo, rubava ai suoi ricchi clienti oggetti preziosi.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Francesca, trovata da suo marito in una pozza di sangue nella loro casa, deve essere operata d'urgenza. Sia lei che il bimbo rischiano di perdere la vita. Intanto Luca, Anna e Irene, indagano su uno strano incidente che coinvolge un loro collega.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Il neonato Francesco, figlio di Roberto e Francesca, viene salvato dopo una lunga operazione. E' subito festeggiato dai fratellini e dagli agenti del X Tuscolano. Il neocommissario capisce che deve affrontare un personaggio del passato, Cesare Carrano.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: La neo ispettrice Irene Valli si trova coinvolta in una rapina nell'emporio, dove lei e suo nipote Stefano, di undici anni, si trovano per caso. I due malviventi non esitano ad uccidere il proprietario del negozio e a picchiare il ragazzino.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Il X° Tuscolano e' alle prese con uno spinoso affare che vede coinvolto un rampante politico: la sua autoblu ha travolto e ucciso un immigrato. Roberto invece si mette sulle tracce del killer Ruggero, figlio dell'imprenditore edile Cesare Carrano.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Fabien Varelle, 31 anni, viene trovato morto in mare. Il giudice Filiponi e la stagista Constance Meyer sono convinti che non sia un incidente, ma un omicidio mascherato.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Constance segue un caso delicato che potrebbe rivelare un errore giudiziario: un uomo è in carcere da 7 anni per l’omicidio della moglie, ma si proclama innocente. Il dramma ha diviso profondamente la sua famiglia.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Uno studente di legge viene trovato morto nella sua stanza al campus universitario, dopo una festa di integrazione. Il giudice e Constance entrano nel mondo della facoltà, tra rivalità e tensioni sociali.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Una giovane donna crede di riconoscere l’aggressore della sua migliore amica, uccisa quattro anni prima. Il giorno dopo l’uomo viene trovato brutalmente assassinato. Le indagini portano a un cargo della marina mercantile.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Un giovane chef stellato, diventato celebre grazie a un talent culinario, viene trovato morto nella cella frigorifera del suo ristorante. Dietro il successo emergono gelosie e rivalità feroci.

programme.title: Call the Midwife: Christmas Special: Episodio 2
programme.desc: Cynthia viene coinvolta in un caso che riguarda gli ex residenti di una clinica psichiatrica vittoriana.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 4, Episodio 3
programme.desc: Mentre Poplar è colpita da una misteriosa ondata di dissenteria, la vita della neomamma Marie Amos viene sconvolta dall'arresto del marito Tony.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 4, Episodio 4
programme.desc: Le levatrici affrontano una delle serate più impegnative che abbiano mai avuto, mentre Suor Winifred concentra i suoi sforzi sulle prostitute di Poplar.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 4, Episodio 5
programme.desc: La fede di Suor Julienne viene messa alla prova quando una madre rifiuta le medicine per il suo neonato.

programme.title: Ercole Al Centro Della Terra
programme.desc: Ercole, in compagnia di Teseo e Telemaco, penetra nell'Averno per cercare di recuperare una pietra dai poteri miracolosi e salvare l'amata Deianira, in pericolo. Giunti nelle tenebre, i quattro dovranno affrontare innumerevoli pericoli.

programme.title: Robin Hood, l'Invincibile Arciere
programme.desc: Robin Hood cerca di aiutare un cavaliere crociato, innamorato di Isabel, perché lo zio della ragazza ha deciso di farla sposare con un altro.

programme.title: Lo Sceicco Rosso
programme.desc: Nel Marocco dell’Ottocento, l’usurpatore Hassan domina il regno sottratto ad Ajabar. Il giovane architetto spagnolo Ruiz, innamorato della principessa Amina, assume l’identità del leggendario Sceicco Rosso per opporsi al tiranno e vendicare il padre.

programme.title: La Vendetta dei Gladiatori
programme.desc: Mentre i barbari di Genserico minacciano Roma, il generale Ezio cade vittima di un tradimento. Suo figlio Fabio e la principessa Priscilla, aiutati da sei valorosi gladiatori, cercano di sfuggire alla violenza degli invasori e salvare il loro amore.

programme.title: Andromeda: Volta dei cieli
programme.desc: Dylan sente delle voci che lo chiamano a un pianeta di "fuoco e ghiaccio".

programme.title: Andromeda: La voce profonda di mezzanotte
programme.desc: Mentre è alla prese con due branchi di Nietzscheani, l'equipaggio cattura un nemico il quale sostiene che una mappa dello slipstream sia nelle mani del suo branco.

programme.title: Andromeda: L'illusione di Maestà
programme.desc: Un errore durante l'uscita dallo slipstream catapulta l'Andromeda nel sistema Prolon. L’equipaggio salva una navicella d’emergenza dalla fine certa, ma il branco la rivuole indietro.

programme.title: Andromeda: Crepuscolo degli idoli
programme.desc: Mentre l'equipaggio è alla ricerca di una colonia perduta di Nietzscheani, scopre che un altro equipaggio li ha aiutati in segreto.

programme.title: Andromeda: Giorno del giudizio, giorno dell'ira
programme.desc: L'equipaggio installa un’AI su una nuova corazzata del Commonwealth, ma ovviamente le cose non vanno come dovrebbero.

programme.title: La mia Super Ex-Ragazza
programme.desc: Quando Jenny/G-Girl diventa eccessivamente possessiva, Matt vorrebbe lasciarla. Ma come fare con una donna che può volare, sollevare un auto e perforare l’acciaio con uno sguardo?

programme.title: Heavenly Match
programme.desc: Casey Heart deve trovare un modo per uscire dalla “friend-zone” mentre si innamora sempre più profondamente del dottor David Swenson.

programme.title: I tempi che cambiano
programme.desc: Antoine (Depardieu) arriva a Tangeri per supervisionare la costruzione di un centro audiovisivo. Lo scopo segreto del viaggio è però di natura personale: ritrovare Cécile (Deneuve), la donna che ha amato per trent'anni con un accanimento silenzioso.

programme.title: Birdman
programme.desc: L'avvincente storia di un attore di film di supereroi e del suo declino.

programme.title: Ladre per Caso
programme.desc: L’introversa Carole e la ribelle Caroline hanno in comune una sola cosa: il padre Patrick, un ladro internazionale ricercato in tutto il mondo. Intenzionato a rubare uno «stradivari» da 15 milioni di euro, chiederà alle figlie di assisterlo nell’impresa.

programme.title: Alex & Emma
programme.desc: Alex è uno scrittore pieno di debiti. Deve scrivere un romanzo entro un mese per avere il denaro con cui saldarli. Contatta la stenografa Emma per aiutarlo nell'impresa. Tra i due si instaura un rapporto che va oltre quello professionale.

programme.title: L'Universale
programme.desc: Anni '70. Tommaso, Alice e Marcello sono tre amici il cui destino si intreccia con quello dell’Universale, storica sala fiorentina, dove il vero spettacolo è il pubblico: il cinema è allo stesso tempo sia il ‘luogo’ che la 'pellicola’

programme.title: Zorro Contro Maciste
programme.desc: Alla morte di Filippo II di Spagna, re di Navarra, le eredi sono le due nipoti: le principesse Malva e Isabella. Malva assolda Maciste per cercare di mettere le mani su un cofanetto contenente il testamento del re e sostituirlo con uno a lei favorevole.

programme.title: Il compleanno
programme.desc: Un gruppo di amici in vacanza è messo in crisi dall'arrivo di un ragazzo: morbosità omertà e passione in un melodramma di rara efficacia.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Guardati le spalle
programme.desc: Quando Les permette a un orologio da $ 60.000 di uscire dalla porta con un accordo di stretta di mano, Seth e Ashley si arrabbiano. La regola della vecchia scuola di Les ripagherà o lascerà la famiglia nei guai?

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Gioielli e zoo americani
programme.desc: Sulla scia dell'affare dell'orologio di Les, Seth e Ashley si mettono al suo caso per frenare i suoi acquisti folli.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Les tutto esaurito
programme.desc: Les ha finalmente sentito abbastanza da Seth e Ashley sul suo affare di cinturino dell'orologio, e scommette che può venderli solo per liberarsi dei bambini.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Puoi scommetterci il culo
programme.desc: Seth e Ashley hanno scommesso sul cervello e iniziano la giornata con una scommessa che ha lasciato uno di loro vestito a festa.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Calore da casa
programme.desc: Ashley è furiosa quando viene tagliata da Les e Seth. Cercando di mantenere la pace - e gli affari senza intoppi - Les separa i fratelli, ma la battaglia si riversa sul piano delle vendite in modo enorme.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Cancellare
programme.desc: La rivalità tra fratelli è ai massimi storici tra Seth e Ashley, e quando lei affronta non uno ma due accordi di baseball che sono chiaramente al di fuori della sua zona di comfort, Seth grida fallo. Les è costretto a misure estreme.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Les va giù
programme.desc: La rissa non è fuori dall'ordinario all'American Jewelry e al prestito, ma quando i clienti buttano giù nel parcheggio prima ancora che le porte si aprano, Les sa che è un brutto segno.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Pilota 1
programme.desc: Dal momento in cui i creditori hanno stretto le cinghie del portafogli e bloccato i prestiti, i residenti di Detroit sanno che possono sempre contare su American Jewelry and Loan, "la banca del lavoratore".

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Pilota 2
programme.desc: Incontrate la famiglia Gold. Come proprietari del più grande banco dei pegni di Detroit, hanno comprato e venduto cose che non potete neanche immaginare.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Contanti pericolosi
programme.desc: Un cliente arrabbiato minaccia Les e mette in allerta l'intero negozio. Nel mezzo del caos, Ashley e Seth fanno una scommessa amichevole sul riuscire a vendere un palo da lap dance.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Alcolici e pistole
programme.desc: I Gold discutono sulla necessità di procurare un arma a tutti all'interno del negozio, dopo che un cliente minaccia Les.

programme.title: Un Natale diverso
programme.desc: Com'è crescere con un padre che crede di essere Babbo Natale? Per Elizabeth Gates (Shelley Long) il sogno di ogni bambino è stato il peggiore degli incubi...che non è finito.

programme.title: Una locanda per Natale
programme.desc: Con i suoi genitori via per le vacanze, Jennifer si lascia alle spalle la vita di città per visitare la locanda della nonna in Alaska.

programme.title: Un matrimonio per Natale
programme.desc: Haley fugge dalla sua infanzia in una piccola città e abbraccia la vita di città come una grande wedding planner.

programme.title: Avengers Grimm: Time Wars
programme.desc: Il sovrano degli Inferi, Tremotino, si nasconde, escogitando dei piani per conquistare la Terra una volta per tutte. Mentre gli Avengers Grimm combattono per fermarlo, scoprono rapidamente che non è dove si nasconde Tremotino, ma quando.

programme.title: Mega Shark Vs Kolossus
programme.desc: Mentre sta cercando una nuova fonte di energia, la Russia risveglia involontariamente un gigantesco robot di nome Kolossus creato ai tempi della guerra fredda. Intanto dal fondo dell'oceano emerge un nuovo Mega Shark che minaccia la terra.

programme.title: Mega Shark vs Crocosaurus
programme.desc: Un enorme squalo preistorico è sopravvissuto all'ultima battaglia e il mondo è ancora minacciato quando un nuovo nemico più pericoloso viene scoperto nelle giungle dell'Africa.

programme.title: Avengers Grimm
programme.desc: Quando Tremotino, malvagio del regno delle fiabe, distrugge lo Specchio magico ed entra nel mondo degli esseri umani, le principesse Cenerentola, Bella Addormentata, Biancaneve e Raperonzolo lo inseguono per batterlo e salvare l'umanità dalla schiavitù.

programme.title: Spara Gringo Spara
programme.desc: A Chad Stark viene offerta una bella somma di dollari se accetta di riportare indietro Fidel, il figlio del proprietario terriero Gutierrez. Fidel si è alleato con una banda di fuorilegge guidata da un ex militare che si fa chiamare “Il Maggiore”.

programme.title: Amico Mio Frega Tu Che Frego Io
programme.desc: Una coppia di amici scopre che esiste dell'oro nascosto nelle Montagne Rocciose. Tutti i cittadini lavorano per diventare ricchi ma la banda di Mulieta ruba il bottino. I due amici decidono di vendicarsi.

programme.title: Joe Bass l'Implacabile
programme.desc: L'oro della banca nazionale viene rapinato ogni volta che viene trasferito. Le autorità affidano allora l'incarico della scorta a Joe Ford il quale ha la bella idea di fondere l'oro e costruirci una carrozza.

programme.title: Dragon
programme.desc: Nel disperato tentativo di salvare il suo regno dall'avanzata di un esercito di elfi oscuri, la principessa Vanir deve attraversare la foresta infestata di Sidhe con l'aiuto dei fedeli avventurieri Cador e Artemir.

programme.title: 100 Gradi Sotto Zero
programme.desc: Quando una catena di eruzioni vulcaniche squarcia l'Europa, una coppia americana deve trovare i loro figli e portarli via da Parigi prima che sia troppo tardi.

programme.title: Planet Dune
programme.desc: Una missione di salvataggio di una base abbandonata su un pianeta desertico diventa mortale quando l'equipaggio si ritrova braccato e attaccato dai predatori del pianeta: i giganteschi vermi della sabbia.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Un Rifugio Per Nessuno Prima Parte
programme.desc: Quando il Santuario è avvicinato da un leader degli anormali per un piano radicale per la pace, Magnus si impegna a dare il suo supporto. Tuttavia, quando Will è costretto a lasciare il Santuario, la sua decisione potrebbe mettere tutti in pericolo.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Un Rifugio Per Nessuno Seconda Parte
programme.desc: La SCIU ha circondato il Quinto Reparto con truppe e uno scudo elettrico che impedisce loro di uscire. Caleb ha un virus che può trasformare la popolazione umana in anormali. Magnus mette in atto il suo piano finale per la rete dei Santuari.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Un Rifugio Per Tutti Prima Parte
programme.desc: La dottoressa Helen Magnus recluta un perspicace psichiatra forense chiamato Will Zimmerman per unirsi a lei nella ricerca di rintracciare, studiare e proteggere le strane e spesso terrificanti creature che popolano segretamente il nostro mondo.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Un Rifugio Per Tutti Seconda Parte
programme.desc: e proteggere le La dottoressa Helen Magnus recluta un perspicace psichiatra forense chiamato Will Zimmerman per unirsi a lei nella ricerca di rintracciare, studiare strane e spesso terrificanti creature che popolano segretamente il nostro mondo.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Fata Morgana
programme.desc: La dottoressa Magnus, sua figlia Ashley e il dottor Will Zimmerman liberano tre donne da una misteriosa cripta in Scozia, riportandole al Santuario per trovare rifugio. All'insaputa della squadra, e delle donne stesse, loro hanno poteri straordinari.

programme.title: Sanctuary: L'uomo Flessibile
programme.desc: Un'indagine su una serie di bizzarre rapine porta Magnus e Will a una banda criminale di ladri che sembrano essere in grado di intrufolarsi tra le crepe della legge... letteralmente.

programme.desc: Un uomo in profonda crisi coniugale instaura una relazione clandestina con la sorella gemella di sua moglie.

programme.desc: Amanda, laureata in ingegneria aeronautica, sta lavorando a un grande progetto ma un collega se ne appropria e lo spaccia per suo. Quando l'uomo viene assassinato, la ragazza diventa la principale sospettata.

programme.title: Disegno di un omicidio
programme.desc: Accusata dell'omicidio del fidanzato e della migliore amica, con cui aveva una relazione, Cassie viene difesa da un noto avvocato penalista

programme.title: Delitti a circuito chiuso

programme.desc: Su un social network virtuale, gli avatar di Charles e Nikki si incontrano e i due si innamorano. Ma quando Nev e Kamie scoprono dettagli strani su Nikki, Charles inizia a chiedersi se il suo sogno di conoscerla diventerà mai realtà.

programme.title: Catfish: False Identità
programme.desc: Dopo 20 anni Motherwolff, satanista e strega, è pronta per David, il suo grande amore. La loro storia d'amore sarà magica come sogna o scoprirà che il diavolo si nasconde nei dettagli?

programme.title: Catfish: False Identità
programme.desc: Dopo essersi tatuato il nome di Lillian, Jass scopre che le foto di Lillian sono false e che il suo vero nome è Kayla! Nev e Kamie aiutano Jess a scoprire con chi abbia parlato veramente e se il suo nome sia Kayla!

programme.title: Catfish: False Identità
programme.desc: Quando Lola capitò nei DM di Onyx, lei penso fosse un dono del cielo. Dopo mesi di incontri andati a monte, Nev e Kamie indagano per scoprire se non si sia trattato invece di una maledizione.

programme.title: Catfish: False Identità
programme.desc: William è innamorato di Carmella ma dopo aver passato molte ore al telefono condividendo dettagli intimi, Carmella non vuole incontrarlo e nemmeno fare una videochiamata. Nev e Kamie aiutano William a scoprire i segreti di Carmella!

programme.title: Catfish: False Identità
programme.desc: John si è innamorata della bella Megan su Facebook, che gli ha persino comprato una tv per i figli. Ma nonostante vivano vicini, Megan continua a trovare scuse. Il migliore amico di John non crede a Megan, sarà davvero l'amore della sua vita?

programme.title: Last Cost: Copenaghen

programme.title: Comedy Central La cena dei cretini
programme.desc: Giorgio si comporta in modo insolito. Sonia ed Enzo infatti scoprono che si è innamorato, ma la sua fidanzata conduce una doppia vita. Intanto in cucina arriva un nuovo aiuto cuoco.

programme.title: Prank and The City: Firenze
programme.desc: Lo show di MTV con protagonisti i TheShow che 'prankerannò un'intera città e gli inconsapevoli abitanti! Oggi a Firenze.

programme.title: Bastardi: Fatma racconta...
programme.desc: Francesca Reggiani segnala a tutte le telespettatrici chi sono, dove vivono e come si comportano i 'bastardi' che infestano le storie d'amore.

programme.title: Bastardi: Raphaela ed il Subacqueo
programme.desc: Francesca Reggiani segnala a tutte le telespettatrici chi sono, dove vivono e come si comportano i 'bastardi' che infestano le storie d'amore.

programme.title: Nick Cannon Presents: Wild 'N Out IT: YBN Cordae / Biz Markie
programme.desc: Nick Cannon, YBN Cordae e Biz Markie si danno battaglia nei giochi: Pick Up & Kill It, Kick 'Em Out The Classroom, Hip Hop History e la battaglia Wildstyle

programme.title: 16 anni e Incinta: Kianna
programme.desc: Con un immaturo fidanzato di 15 anni, una madre lontana e un padre assente, Kianna vorrebbe maggiore stabilità per il suo bambino e prende in considerazione l'adozione. Nessuno però l'appoggia.

programme.title: 16 anni e Incinta: Taylor
programme.desc: La madre di Taylor vorrebbe che lei desse in adozione il bambino. Taylor e il fidanzato Nathan, invece, si sentono in grado di affrontare le responsabilità di essere genitori teenager.

programme.title: 16 anni e Incinta: Allie
programme.desc: Allie, dopo essere andata a vivere con l'anomala famiglia del suo ragazzo, deve decidere se è meglio far crescere suo figlio in un contesto familiare instabile oppure senza la figura del padre.

programme.title: 16 anni e Incinta: Le loro vite oggi
programme.desc: Drew incontra Jenelle, Nikkole, Valerie, Chelsea, Lori, Samantha, Nicole, Leah, Lizzie and Kailyn insieme ai fidanzati e alle loro famiglie per raccontare la maternità in età Teen.

programme.title: 16 anni e Incinta: Scene Inedite
programme.desc: Dr. Drew dà un occhio ai momenti esclusivi ed inediti di questa stagione di 16 Anni e Incinta.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Il Calcio è Proibito!
programme.desc: In seguito all’amichevole Giappone-Stati Uniti, in cui il gioco dei locali si è dimostrato scorretto e violento, la legge ha vietato il calcio.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: La Protocollo Omega 2.0!
programme.desc: È in corso la partita amichevole tra stati uniti e Giappone rappresentati rispettivamente dalla Raimon e dalla Protocollo Omega 2.0, in vantaggio di 10 punti.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Allenamento al Giardino Imperiale!
programme.desc: È notte e Arion ripensa al suo allenatore Mark che si è sacrificato per salvare lui e la sua squadra. La mattina successiva, assieme a Fey e ai rimanenti membri della Raimon, apprende dalla professoressa Hills.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: L’Armatura dello Spirito Guerriero
programme.desc: JP, Arion, Ryoma, Riccardo e Victor si stanno scontrando contro la divisione a5, la squadra formata dai 5 giocatori della Protocollo Omega che vogliono vendicare Alpha.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Gli Insegnamenti del Maestro
programme.desc: I giocatori della Raimon junior high (Victor, Arion, Ryoma, Riccardo e JP) viaggiano nel futuro per introdursi all'interno di un museo commemorativo del calcio che fra duecento anni custodirà un libro, “gli insegnamenti del maestro”.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone
programme.desc: Arion e gli altri sono a casa di zia silvia e cercano di decifrare i misteriosi quaderni che – secondo le loro informazioni – contengono le istruzioni per creare la squadra invincibile.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Alla Ricerca della Squadra Invincibile
programme.desc: Ricomincia la partita contro la Protocollo Omega 2.0 e il maestro decide di aiutare la Raimon dichiarando che la chiave per la vittoria è in 3d. I ragazzi all’inizio non capiscono e pensano che si riferisca a qualcosa che inizia con la lettera d.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Il Villaggio di Nobunaga
programme.desc: I nostri protagonisti si trovano nel 1554, all'epoca di Nobunaga oda. Il loro obiettivo è cercare di impossessarsi dell'aura di Nobunaga per costituire la squadra più forte di tutti i tempi.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Contro la Banda dei Cervi Bianchi!
programme.desc: Comincia la sfida tra la Raimon e la banda dei cervi bianchi, ipnotizzati e comandati da beta. Tasuke e i suoi quattro amici si uniscono alla Raimon per ovviare alla carenza di giocatori, ma i ragazzi non hanno idea di come si giochi a calcio.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Operazione Danza
programme.desc: Il gruppo di Arion si trova nel Giappone feudale, con l'obiettivo di catturare l'aura del signore del luogo, tale Nobunaga, e trasferirla a Riccardo. Mentre quest'ultimo si allena per riuscire ad accogliere e trattenere l'aura di Nobunaga.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Allenamento nell'Owari
programme.desc: Arion e gli altri si trovano di fronte a Nobunaga e viene chiesto loro di discolparsi dall'accusa di voler attentare alla sua vita, magari per conto del rivale Imagawa.
