programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Du Stal Min Dröm, Brorsan
programme.desc: När Max vinner skolvalet som Phoebe hade jobbat så hårt för, planerar hon sin hämnd.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Thundersinne
programme.desc: Phoebe får förmågan att ana fara innan den har hänt, och använder sitt nyfunna sinne för att imponera på sina klasskamrater. Under tiden låtsas Max att han inte har fått sitt sinne ännu för att få presenter av Barb.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Ha en Cool Födelsedag
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max vill få lov att hålla ett födelsedagsparty som normala tonåringar, men när en nedfryst fru Wong kommer bort och dom måste hitta henne, inser de hur bra deras familjepartyn faktiskt är.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Upp, upp och semester!
programme.desc: Familjen Thunderman deltar i en familjetävling för att vinna en drömsemester, men de har olika idéer om vart de ska åka. När de inte kan enas deltar de som två skilda lag, killar mot tjejer, och så får vinnaren bestämma.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Inget är som ett pyjamasparty
programme.desc: Phoebe håller sitt första pyjamasparty och använder psykokinesi för att rädda det från att bli en katastrof. Som bestraffning måste hon ha på sig ett ankelband som hindrar henne från att använda sina krafter, så hon ber Max om hjälp.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Små Vita Körer
programme.desc: När en elak tjej vid namn Veronica saboterar för Phoebe i kören och utnyttjar Max genom att få honom att göra hennes läxor, samarbetar tvillingarna för att ta hämnd på henne.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Kidnapping
programme.desc: In 2001, Ginger Hayes and her infant son were abducted during a carjacking. The crime had been reported by a witness within minutes of occurrence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sands of Crime
programme.desc: In the early hours of a morning just before Christmas, a college student was abducted from the parking lot of her apartment. Her body was found later that day; she had been sexually assaulted and shot at point-blank range.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Calculated Coincidence
programme.desc: A young woman is found dead in her apartment. With little evidence at the scene, the case turns cold — until police discover a link between their prime suspect and an unsolved murder committed six years earlier in a different state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sworded Scheme
programme.desc: When a college student is reported missing, police believe their investigation will be like countless others. But when they discover blood spatter in her boyfriend's bedroom, they know this case is going to be different.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unmasked
programme.desc: A serial rapist is on the loose in a Texas town. No one knew where he'd strike next, but the audacity of his attacks and the escalation of violence against his victims made finding him imperative.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fashion Police
programme.desc: The victim had been stabbed more than thirty times and the crime scene was awash with her blood. Near her head, police discovered a distinctive button with strands of thread still attached.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Dis-service
programme.desc: A young woman attends evening church services, then disappears. When her abandoned car is found, the tank is empty and a gas can she kept in her trunk for emergencies is missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seedy Intentions
programme.desc: When a 9-year-old girl goes missing, police and volunteers spend weeks searching for her. A psychic's vision leads to a field where her body is discovered, along with what investigators hope is enough evidence to find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: DNA Dragnet
programme.desc: Digital enhancement of security camera footage shows that what appears to be a casual encounter is actually a forced abduction. When investigators suspect the crimes are not random, they fear a serial killer may be on the loose.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smiley Face
programme.desc: The woman had been sexually assaulted, stabbed repeatedly and left for dead. When a perfect suspect practically turned himself in, police were sure they had their man until DNA evidence proved them wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: The victim was a self-made man who never minced words. Perhaps he was murdered by a disgruntled client or employee. Perhaps the racy photos in his safe held the clue to solving the crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly intentions
programme.desc: When abduction turns to murder, forensic science is the only key to finding justice for the victims of a kidnapper's deadly intentions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Traces Of Guilt
programme.desc: Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence: a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Soldier Stories
programme.desc: This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Vanished
programme.desc: In New York, an ambitious college student has her whole life ahead of her, until she crosses the path of a killer. It's a random murder, the hardest kind to solve.

programme.title: Crime Down Under: Undercover: Going Under
programme.desc: The official undercover program is launched in the 1970s, as agents begin the war against drugs and take on the might of the Mr Asia crime ring.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Slaughter of Innocence
programme.desc: A young Asian student is raped and murdered in the apartment she shares with her sister. The killer has left a minute trace of himself in the apartment. His identity is a complete mystery. Who could have killed this innocent girl and why?

programme.desc: A woman goes missing in Summerside, PEI. The blood inside her abandoned car tells a terrible story. DNA confirms the blood on a splattered man’s jacket matches that of the missing woman. The jacket is also covered with white cat hairs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Dalsland

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Stockholm

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lolland

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Skåne

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Sjuhärad

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Avsnitt 508

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Avsnitt 502

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Avsnitt 205

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 1107

programme.title: I Huvudet På En Gärningsman SV: Avsnitt 207
programme.desc: Historien om de två pedofilbröderna uppdagas i början av 2017. Under 15 års tid har de förgripit sig på flera barn, när polisen senare gör en husrannsakan i deras hem hittas tusentals bilder och filmer.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Evilmans

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Den Blåa Detektiven
programme.desc: När Max hud blir blå under en dejt blir alla misstänkta när han agerar superdetektiv för att finna den skyldiga.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All that Glitters is Gold
programme.desc: Police discover a bullet-riddled car, a missing driver and no witnesses. Had the victim been abducted or was she dead? The answers are found in a unique clue, so tiny it was measured in millionths of a meter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Rebellion

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Crime
programme.desc: In little more than a month, two women who lived in the same apartment complex were brutally murdered. The similarities of the crime scenes led police to conclude they were dealing with a serial killer who harbored an intense hatred of women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Covet Thy Neighbour
programme.desc: When a college student vanished without a trace, her fellow students were concerned about her safety and their own.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writing on the Wall

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hundreds of Reasons

programme.title: Forensic Files: Separation Anxiety
programme.desc: Tracey Frame, 35, was convicted of killing David Nixon in April 2002 after he planned to end their relationship.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Office Visit

programme.title: Forensic Files: Palm Saturday
programme.desc: At the scene of a vicious murder, the killer went to a great deal of effort to wipe away his fingerprints and obscure his shoe impressions left when he tracked blood trails on the floor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoe-In For Murder
programme.desc: In 2007, Brian and Beverly Mauck were found dead in their Graham, Washington home. Using a bloody palm print and shoe prints at the scene, investigators focus their attention on Daniel Tavares, who had previously inked a tattoo on Brian's back.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing

programme.title: The New Detectives: Presumed Dead

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Chemistry

programme.title: The New Detectives: Death Grip

programme.desc: I juli 2008 skriver den då 25-årige Varg Nielsen i sin dagbok: “snart ett mord. vet vem, när, hur”. Två dagar senare träffar han en 23 årig småbarnsmamma och mördar henne med 40 knivhugg.

programme.title: I Huvudet På En Gärningsman SV: Avsnitt 204
programme.desc: En kvinna ringer till SOS om att hennes sambo plötsligt blivit sjuk, varpå han körs akut till sjukhus. Det kommer visa sig att hon försökt giftmörda sin sambo - och det är inte heller första gången.

programme.title: Svenska fall
programme.desc: En försommardag 2017 anmäler en mamma att hennes dotter Tova är försvunnen. En stor polisinsats inleds, och efter någon dag hittar man Tovas kropp, fastsurrad i en skottkärra som sänkts i en sjö.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Avsnitt 305
programme.desc: Den 19 december 1994 klev Bjørn Thore Langemyhr på ett tåg från Tønsberg till Oslo. Det är det sista familjen ser av honom. När han inte dyker upp hemma på julafton slår familjen larm.

programme.title: Svenska fall
programme.desc: På en åker utanför Enköping hittas en ung man död. Vid första anblicken ser det ut som om han lagt sig ner för att vila – men när polisen granskar kroppen upptäcker de vad som tros vara en skottskada.

programme.title: Secret War: Agent Garbo

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Controllers (Part 1)
programme.desc: Leonard Nimoy and guest star Dina Merrill join the Impossible Missions Force to fight a mind-destroying drug that could enslave the free world in the first of a two-part episode.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Controllers (Part 2)
programme.desc: Jim Phelps lets himself be framed for murder in a scheme to discredit a scientist who has developed a mind-destroying drug in the second of a two-part episode on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Code
programme.desc: Leonard Nimoy becomes a member of the Impossible Missions Force and, as Paris of the IMF, helps crack a vital code by hijacking a plane so the enemy can capture one of the passengers

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Mastermind
programme.desc: In a battle with organized crime, the IMF sets up a bizarre mind-transfer experiment to convince a syndicate leader he is being double-crossed on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: MacGyver: The Eraser
programme.desc: MacGyver is enjoying playing in a scrimmage with a professional hockey team when Pete Thornton recruits him to solve an international espionage case.

programme.title: MacGyver: The Human Factor
programme.desc: MacGyver is called in to test the unique security system of a top-secret research and development lab. The system, which is designed to entrap and exterminate intruders, malfunctions, trapping its creator, Jill Ludlum, and MacGyver inside.

programme.title: MacGyver: Eagles
programme.desc: In the wilderness, MacGyver and 10-year-old Darin Cooper intervene to save the lives of a pair of golden eagles injured by poachers. The poachers go after MacGyver -- witness to their crime -- and taking Darin and his mother hostage.

programme.title: MacGyver: The Wish Child
programme.desc: MacGyver fights to save a young boy from the ominous fate of a centuries-old legend.

programme.title: MacGyver: Twice Stung
programme.desc: MacGyver, Pete Thornton, and Joanne Remmings (The Phoenix Foundation's resident bunco expert) pull a sting operation against a con man who cheated their friend out of his life savings.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Episod 506
programme.desc: En liten lägenhet i Vanløse och två små barn - inte den bästa kombinationen. Lisa och Erling drömmer om ett stort hus med en trädgård. Tobias måste jobba hårt eftersom hans drömmar är större än budgeten.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 601
programme.desc: Nathja, Kristian och deras nyfödda dotter bor i en ombyggd butik med en lucka i sovrummet. Kristian drömmer om ett stort garage och Nathja vill hellre stanna i Køge - kan Tobias förverkliga deras drömmar?

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 602
programme.desc: Maja och Kenneth bor i Västjylland och drömmer om att komma närmare Majas familj i Silkeborg. Men deras budget kräver att de kompromissar med platsen och letar i närliggande småstäder.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 603
programme.desc: I Ikast är Camilla och Marc sugna på ett hus med utrymme för förvaring. Men när Tobias hittar ett stort hus till dem blir paret besvikna när de upptäcker att det finns SÅ många rum att renovera...

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Att Hitta en Hit

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Superbarnvakterna

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Middagsbjudning

programme.title: Forensic Files: Watchful Eye

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Material Witness

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scent Of The Kill

programme.title: The New Detectives: From The Ashes
programme.desc: Arson Investigation: Insurance torchings, mob burnouts and arson murders: these crimes are designed to take all clues with them. But a solid case can be built from a heap of ashes.

programme.title: The New Detectives: The Unforgotten
programme.desc: Years after a murder has been committed, investigators use advanced DNA analysis to shed new light on crimes that have gone unpunished for far too long.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Error

programme.title: Secret War: Agent Garbo
programme.desc: Juan Pujol, MI6's WWII agent "Garbo," created a fictitious spy network in Lisbon, deceiving the Germans with crucial disinformation and influencing their strategies. After the war, MI6 protected him, and he lived in Venezuela until his death in 1988.

programme.title: Secret War: The Mafia Connection
programme.desc: Lucky Luciano, a mafia boss of the 1930s, was in jail in 1942 on charges of running prostitution rings. US intelligence services did a deal with him and he got the Italians to share intelligence on German U boat movements.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Vidkun Quisling

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Nazis Outfought
programme.desc: By 1944, Hitler's image as a victorious leader is crumbling. He faces a bomb plot led by Stauffenberg and Tresckow, intending to kill him and overthrow the regime. Hitler survives the bombing, triggering a brutal reprisal against conspirators.

programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.desc: MacGyver and a deaf school teacher, Carrie Linden, live out a nightmare when they stumble upon an ex-CIA agent's ingenious plan to steal a missile, piece by piece, and sell it on the black market.

programme.title: MacGyver: Three for the Road

programme.desc: MacGyver is the Thorntons only hope when they are taken hostage in the swamps of Louisiana by an ex-agent seeking revenge.

programme.title: MacGyver: Soft Touch
programme.desc: MacGyver uncovers an assassination plot against an informer threatening to expose a drug trafficking network.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 702

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 703
programme.desc: I Esbjerg har Line och Kristian byggt sitt drömhus, eller det är vad de trodde. Öppna ytor och stora fönster faller dem inte längre i smaken, men vad ska de istället ha?

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 704
programme.desc: För några år sedan sålde Birgitte sitt hus, och ångrade det bittert. Nu hyr hon och dottern Emma ett dyrt nybygge medan de letar efter ett hus som liknar det gamla. Kan experterna hjälpa dem?

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 705
programme.desc: Pernille och Aron jobbpendlar den långa sträckan från Odense till Kalundborg varje dag. Drömmen är att bo närmare jobbet, så de kan ägna sin fritid åt något annat än att att sitta i en bil.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: On The Pull

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Sneaking Off To Byron Bay

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Family Reunion
programme.desc: Halva gänget drar till Byron Bay, medan Chloe och Nathan är hemma utan att snacka. Sophie är på jakt efter kärleken. Abbie och Grant kommer närmare varandra, och kommer Sams och Chloes kärlek att överleva?

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The Next Step

programme.title: Henry Danger: Vilddjuret Henry

programme.title: Henry Danger: Osynlige Brad

programme.title: Henry Danger: Varning för Spoiler

programme.title: Henry Danger: Superstängt

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Jews Who Fought for Hitler
programme.desc: In Hitler’s Germany, those with Jewish ancestry faced harsh Nuremberg Laws. Full Jews faced death; Mischlinge endured discrimination, job bans. Some, like Helmut Schmidt, unaware of heritage, found protectors like Milch in high places.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Preparing for War
programme.desc: Hitler unveils his military plans: annex Austria, seize the Sudetenland, and eventually invade Poland and the Soviet Union. By March 1938, Austria falls bloodlessly. By September 1939, he invades Poland, sparking World War Two.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Gatling Gun, designed to change 19th-century battlefields, now reigns supreme in the skies as a high-speed offensive weapon. With a 150-year legacy of havoc it continues to be a formidable force.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Could the mighty M2 be the greatest machine gun in history? Nicknamed “Ma Deuce”, this American machine gun has dominated battlefields for over 80 years. Host Wil Willis tests it and recreates Audie Murphy’s famous Medal of Honor moment.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: End Game
programme.desc: In January 1945, Nazi Germany faces defeat as Allied armies close in. Hitler, aged 55 and in poor health, remains defiant in his Berlin bunker. On April 30th, 1945, Hitler commits suicide, and days later, Germany surrenders, ending World War II.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Weapons That Changed The World examines the RPG-7, renowned for its ability to take on tanks and level buildings. Host Wil Willis traces its evolution from WWII's Bazooka to modern counterparts like the AT-4 and Carl Gustav.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In June 1984, 15-year-old cheerleader Kirsten Costas was lured out and stabbed five times by jealous classmate Bernadette Protti in Orinda, California. The case inspired the TV movie Death of a Cheerleader.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1967, 75-year-old widow Louisa Dunne was raped and strangled in her Bristol home. The case remained unsolved for 57 years until DNA evidence led to the 2025 conviction of 92-year-old Ryland Headley.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In January 1999, 28-year-old Meekiah Wadley was bound and smothered in her Richmond, CA home, leaving her infant daughter behind. The cold case was finally solved 22 years later through familial DNA technology.

programme.title: Gabulosis: A Summer Boy Scout Trip That Turned Into a Decades Long Mystery: What Happened to Garrett Bardsley?
programme.desc: On August 20, 2004 Garrett Bardsley told his father he was going to walk back to camp to change his clothes after falling in the water while they were fishing. He was never seen again and no clues have ever surfaced.

programme.title: Gabulosis: The Tragic Case of the Boy in the Bundle
programme.desc: On July 11, 1963 a fisher in the Keene Creek in Ashland, Oregon reeled in a small bundle. At the center of this bundle was the body of a small boy. A boy who would be unidentified for until 2021.

programme.title: Ace in the Hole
programme.desc: A cave collapse traps a man, and all eyes turn toward the tragedy, including those of Charles "Chuck" Tatum (Kirk Douglas), a washed-up newspaper reporter who sees the incident as a ticket back to his former days at the top of the journalism heap.

programme.title: Paths Of Glory
programme.desc: This powerful, fact-based absurdity-of-war film stars Kirk Douglas as a commanding officer who defends three scapegoats on trial for a failed offensive that occurred within the French Army in 1916.

programme.title: Detective Story
programme.desc: Kirk Douglas stars as the rigid detective whose personal code has become twisted from dealing with too many criminals. Eleanor Parker is his wife, tormented by a guilty secret.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back and gain the freedom of his people in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Troy
programme.desc: Throughout time, men have waged war. Some for power, some for glory, some for honor ... and some for love.

programme.title: Fight Club
programme.desc: A detached man and his friend organize brutal, bare-knuckle boxing matches.

programme.title: Carrie (2002)
programme.desc: Angela Bettis stars in this adaptation of Stephen King's classic tale of horror. Carrie White has been cursed with the power of telekinesis and when her tormenters commit an act of unforgivable humiliation, they'll soon learn a deadly lesson.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: When four teenagers all meet with mysterious deaths exactly one week after watching a videotape, investigative reporter Rachel Keller tracks down the video... and watches it.

programme.title: Hush
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray and his adopted son, Quick, run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Gangster Bugsy Calhoune pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone to close Club Sugar Ray down.

programme.title: Coming to America
programme.desc: Join EDDIE MURPHY on an unforgettable comic quest to the New World. As an African Prince, it's time for him to find a princess. The mission leads him and his most loyal friend (ARSENIO HALL) to New York. Watch Murphy and Hall in classic cameo roles!

programme.title: The Golden Child
programme.desc: As ‘The Chosen One’, Murphy’s on a madcap mission to save The Golden Child, a youth with mystical powers who’s been abducted by an evil cult.

programme.title: Martial Law
programme.desc: Sean Thompson and Billie Blake are a part of the L.A.P.D.'s new program called 'Martial Law'. When they begin to tangle with criminal and kung fu master Dalton Rhodes, it becomes personal...

programme.title: Martial Law II: Undercover
programme.desc: Two undercover cops investigating a murder uncover a deadly ring of corruption at a nightclub where the rich are entertained by seductive women and protected by martial arts experts.

programme.title: Cyborg
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi thriller as Gibson Rickenbacker, the future's most fearsome warrior. In the wake of a plague, Rickenbacker must rescue the only person who can develop a vaccine and save civilization.

programme.title: Death Warrant
programme.desc: Action superstar Jean-Claude van Damme ("Bloodsport", "Cyborg") is a veteran undercover cop posing as an inmate in a dangerously corrupt state prison.

programme.title: Wayne's World 2
programme.desc: Having achieved godlike status as a late-night TV personality, Wayne now confronts the question that has plagued man for centuries: Is there life after cable?

programme.title: The Ladies Man (2000)
programme.desc: Leon loses his radio show because of his X-rated on-air comments. He then gets a letter from a former flame promising him a lifetime of wealth and happiness, and things start looking up!

programme.title: A Night at the Roxbury
programme.desc: It seems like Steve and Doug will never be cool enough to make the Roxbury club’s guest list. Until they have a fender bender with their role model, club regular Richard Grieco. Eager to avoid litigation, Grieco befriends the starstruck pair.

programme.title: Superstar
programme.desc: All Mary Katherine Gallagher wants in life is a kiss. Not just any kiss, mind you – a Hollywood-style kiss. But no matter how hard she tries, no one will kiss her. She decides that to get her kiss, she must become just like the people in the movies.

programme.title: Girl Most Likely
programme.desc: Kristen Wiig stars in this sweet and funny movie about a failed playwright who is forced to move home with her eccentric mother (Annette Bening).

programme.title: Chef
programme.desc: Chef quits his job in LA after refusing to compromise with its owner; he is left to figure out what's next. He teams up with his ex, a friend & his son to launch a food truck, reigniting his passion for the kitchen and zest for life.

programme.title: New Year's Eve
programme.desc: Set in New York on New Year's Eve, this romantic comedy celebrates love, hope, forgiveness, second chances, and fresh starts through the intertwining stories of couples and singles, told amid the pulse and promise of the most dazzling night of the year.

programme.title: Crimson Tide
programme.desc: The USS Alabama receives an unconfirmed order to launch its missiles.

programme.title: Déjà Vu
programme.desc: If you thought it was just a trick of the mind, prepare yourself for the truth.

programme.title: Body of Lies
programme.desc: Leonardo Di Caprio and Academy Award winner Russell Crowe star in director Ridley Scott's adaptation of the best-selling post-9/11 espionage thriller.

programme.title: Man on Fire (2004)
programme.desc: A Marine swears vengeance on those who committed an act against the family he was hired to protect.

programme.title: The Patriot
programme.desc: In 1776, South Carolina widower and legendary war hero Benjamin Martin (Mel Gibson) finds himself thrust into the midst of the American Revolutionary War as he helplessly watches his family torn apart by the savage British Redcoats.

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Clint Eastwood and Academy Award-winner Steven Spielberg comes the life stories of the six men who raised the flag at The Battle of Iwo Jima, a turning point in WWII.

programme.title: Any Given Sunday
programme.desc: Academy Award winner Al Pacino and Cameron Diaz lead a stellar cast in Oscar-winning Oliver Stone's hard-hitting homage to the gridiron gladiators of Any Given Sunday.

programme.title: Renegade
programme.desc: Mattie, a young lady living in a mine camp of the Southwest, unwittingly marries a claim jumper despite the fact she is in love with a gold miner. Soon, the Old West brings her death, confusion and the hard reality of her claim jumping husband.

programme.title: Billy the Kid
programme.desc: When a bounty hunter kills a member of an outlaw gang, all Hell breaks loose in this shoot-‘em-up tale of gun smoke and justice in the Old West.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

programme.title: GoodFellas
programme.desc: Director Martin Scorsese exposes the fascinating, mysterious, and violent underworld of New York's Mafia families through the life of insider Henry Hill.

programme.title: Bringing Out the Dead
programme.desc: Frank Pierce, a paramedic, is on the brink of madness from too many years of saving and losing lives. One fateful night, Frank meets Mary Burke, the daughter of a man Frank tried to save. Together, Frank and Mary confront the ghosts of the past.

programme.title: Gangs Of New York
programme.desc: Martin Scorsese's epic film set in mid-19th century Lower Manhattan tells the story of a young Irish immigrant (Leonardo DiCaprio) seeking revenge against the rival gang leader who killed his father.

programme.title: The Barrens
programme.desc: A weekend getaway turns murderous at the Wharton State Pine Barrens, as a family starts to believe they’ve encountered the legendary Jersey Devil. Starring Stephen Moyer (TV’s TRUE BLOOD).

programme.title: Hell House LLC.
programme.desc: Five years after an unexplained malfunction causes the death of 15 tour-goers and staff on the opening night of a Halloween haunted house tour, a documentary crew travels back to the scene of the tragedy to find out what really happened.

programme.title: Texas Chainsaw Massacre 3D
programme.desc: A young woman inherits an isolated mansion from a distant relative, but an unspeakable horror awaits her in the mansion's dank cellars.

programme.title: The Goonies
programme.desc: With brothers Mikey and Brand's house slated for demolition by greedy developers, the boys' only hope lies in finding a long-lost treasure. They uncover a treasure map and, with their friends, descend to a subterranean sea and an abandoned galleon.

programme.title: Poltergeist
programme.desc: At first, the spirits that invade the Freelings' home seem like playful children. But then they turn angry. And when 10-year-old Carol Anne is pulled from this world into another, Steve and Diane Freeling turn to an exorcist.

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: A single mother and her two sons discover much more than they anticipated in this visually stunning blend of hip humor, horror, and rock 'n' roll about the most compelling group of contemporary vampires ever to put fang to vein.

programme.title: Dirty Dancing
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey star in this spirit-lifting story about a summer love affair between a naïve 17-year-old girl and a charismatic dance instructor at a Catskills hotel. Rated PG-13

programme.title: The Time Machine
programme.desc: Hoping to alter the events of the past, a 19th-century inventor instead travels 800,000 years into the future, where he finds humankind divided into two warring races.

programme.title: D.A.R.Y.L.
programme.desc: A young boy is found wandering, with no memory of who he is. A family takes him in and begins to look for clues to help him find his way home.

programme.title: Clue
programme.desc: Meet all the notorious suspects and discover their foul playthings. You'll love their dastardly doings as the bodies and the laughs pile up before your eyes. Featuring all three surprise endings!!

programme.title: Reservoir Dogs
programme.desc: After a seemingly perfectly planned robbery goes awry, a group of criminals begins to suspect a traitor in their ranks, and back at their headquarters, they try to suss out the culprit.

programme.title: Jackie Brown
programme.desc: A female flight attendant becomes a key figure in a plot between the police and an arms dealer.

programme.title: Heist
programme.desc: A jewel thief's nephew is sent along on a heist to ensure a longtime partner in crime stays honest about the division of the loot.

programme.title: Burlesque
programme.desc: A small-town singer moves to the big city for her chance at stardom when she discovers Burlesque, a glamorous nightclub packed with dancers, sizzling musical numbers, and an owner in need of a star.

programme.title: Jerry Maguire
programme.desc: Jerry Maguire is a sports agent who reaches a crisis point in his life when he decides to become an honorable man. Follow his journey to redemption through an unlikely alliance with a female accountant, and his least important client.

programme.title: Fargo
programme.desc: Things go awry when car salesman Jerry Lundegaard (William H. Macy) hires two thugs to kidnap his wife. Soon, the very pregnant and chipper Police Chief Marge Gunderson (Frances McDormand) takes the case. Is she up for the challenge? You betcha.

programme.title: Sense and Sensibility
programme.desc: Emma Thompson stars in the captivating romance based on Jane Austen's classic novel of two sisters' search for love in strict Victorian society.

programme.title: Sleepless in Seattle
programme.desc: Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan star in an enchanting romance about a widower whose son convinces him to find new love and the woman who answers his call.

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Multiple Academy Award winner Tom Hanks reunites with his Sleepless in Seattle co-star, Meg Ryan, and director Nora Ephron, to discover love at first byte in this online romantic comedy.

programme.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
programme.desc: This dazzling remake of the 1956 spine-tingler stars Donald Sutherland, Brooke Adams, Jeff Goldblum, Leonard Nimoy and Veronica Cartwright in an eerie tale of possession by "alien pods."

programme.title: The Warriors
programme.desc: The armies of the night number 100,000; they outnumber the police 5 to 1; and tonight they're after the Warriors.

programme.title: The Little Girl Who Lives Down The Lane
programme.desc: Jodie Foster and Martin Sheen star in this haunting story of a thirteen-year-old girl who lives in an old house with her reclusive father...all alone. Or does she? It seems she is hiding a dark secret, one she is determined to preserve. At any cost!

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: The non-human machine ruling elite of the nuclear war-torn future has dispatched a cyborg assassin into the past to kill a young boy because he soon will be the resistance leader against the machines.

programme.title: Terminator Genisys
programme.desc: When John Connor sends Kyle Reese back to 1984 to protect a young Sarah Connor, unexpected events alter the past and threaten the future of all mankind. Charged with a new mission, Reese must join forces with Sarah and her "Guardian" to save the world.

programme.title: Blade Runner: The Final Cut
programme.desc: Harrison Ford stars in this fascinating, dark vision of the near future as a policeman who tracks engineered humans — a Blade Runner.

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: Harrison Ford reprises his iconic role as a relentless blade runner hunting down escaped replicants in a dystopian 21st-century Los Angeles.

programme.title: Ghosts of Girlfriends Past
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey stars with Jennifer Garner in this romantic comedy about a committed bachelor who gets a wake-up call from his late, legendary, hard-partying Uncle Wayne and his own Ghosts of Girlfriends Past.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: A high-school boy is given the chance to write a story for Rolling Stone Magazine about an up-and-coming rock band as he accompanies it on their concert tour.

programme.title: Role Models
programme.desc: The world's least likely mentors must set aside their selfish ways to impart invaluable wisdom to two kids about life, love, and heavy metal.

programme.title: Miller's Girl
programme.desc: A creative writing assignment yields complex results between a teacher and his talented student.

programme.title: Alice, Darling
programme.desc: Pushed to the breaking point, a woman enjoys some much-needed time away from her psychologically abusive boyfriend. However, when his vengeance is unleashed, it tests her strength, her courage, and the bonds of deep-rooted friendships.

programme.title: Into the Deep
programme.desc: A woman's whirlwind romance with a handsome stranger soon turns into a web of deceit, mistrust and violence aboard his yacht.

programme.title: Mrs. Doubtfire
programme.desc: An eccentric dad dresses as a British nanny to care for his kids at their mother's home.

programme.title: Good Will Hunting
programme.desc: The hit Oscar-winning drama, which launched the careers of Matt Damon and Ben Affleck, tells the tale of a headstrong, working-class genius who's failing the lessons of life until he meets a relatable psychology professor (Robin Williams).

programme.title: Popeye
programme.desc: The legendary, beloved anvil-armed sailor of the seven seas comes magically to life in this delightful musical, starring Robin Williams as Popeye, who meets all challenges with the unshakable philosophy, "I yam what I yam and that's all that I yam."

programme.title: Mrs. Doubtfire
programme.desc: An eccentric dad dresses as a British nanny to care for his kids at their mother's home.

programme.title: All Dirt Roads Taste of Salt
programme.desc: A richly layered ode to the generations of people and places that shape us in a lyrical, decades-spanning exploration of a woman's life in Mississippi. The haunting feature debut from award-winning artist Raven Jackson.

programme.title: Earth Mama
programme.desc: With two children in foster care, Gia, a pregnant single mother pitted against the system, fights to reclaim her family. In her close-knit Bay Area community, she works to make a life for herself and her kids.

programme.title: Moonlight
programme.desc: A look at three defining chapters in the life of Chiron, a young Black man growing up in Miami. His epic journey to manhood is guided by the kindness, support, and love of the community that helps raise him.

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: It’s the 23rd century, and an alien power is evaporating the oceans. To save mankind, Kirk and his crew must time-travel back to 1986, where they find a world of punk, pizza, and exact-change buses that are as alien as anything they’ve ever encountered.

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: Captain Kirk and his crew must deal with Mr. Spock's long-lost half-brother, who hijacks the Enterprise for an obsessive search for God at the center of the galaxy.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: After years of war, the Federation and the Klingon Empire find themselves on the brink of a peace summit when an apparent attack from the Enterprise nearly destroys a Klingon ship. Both worlds brace for what may be their deadliest encounter.

programme.title: Pretty Woman
programme.desc: Julia Roberts and Richard Gere star in an irresistible comedy hit.

programme.title: Father of the Bride
programme.desc: Steve Martin turns in a heartwarming and hilarious performance.

programme.title: Bad Santa
programme.desc: Arguably the most outrageous Christmas tale ever told, Billy Bob Thornton is a thieving Santa who doesn't care if you've been naughty or nice. Hot on his trail are a security guard, a sexy bartender, and the one kid who's convinced he's the real deal.

programme.title: Creed II
programme.desc: The next chapter in the Creed story follows Adonis Creed's life inside and outside the ring as he deals with newfound fame, family issues, and his ongoing quest to become a champion, with Michael B. Jordan and Sylvester Stallone starring.

programme.title: Creed III
programme.desc: After dominating the boxing world, Adonis Creed has been thriving in his career and family life. But now he puts his future on the line to battle a fighter -- and former friend -- who has absolutely nothing to lose…and everything to gain.

programme.title: Rocky
programme.desc: As the boxer 'everyman' Rocky Balboa, Sylvester Stallone comes out swinging with heart, humor, and unforgettable power as he 'goes the distance' against World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) in this unforgettable, Oscar®- winning film!

programme.title: Vampire in Brooklyn
programme.desc: As the vampire Maximillian, the popular star is the most diabolical, dashing, and definitely undead dude in the ‘hood.

programme.title: Norbit
programme.desc: Murphy stars as mild-mannered Norbit, who gets a second chance at love with his childhood sweetheart, Kate. However, obstacles may make this romance slightly more difficult than expected.

programme.title: Top Five
programme.desc: Written, directed and starring Chris Rock, TOP FIVE tells the story of New York City comedian-turned-film star Andre Allen, whose unexpected encounter with a journalist forces him to confront the comedy career—and the past—that he’s left behind.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt, a secret agent, is framed for the deaths of his espionage team and attempts to flee from government assassins after him. He races against the clock to discover the truth.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible II
programme.desc: The world's greatest spy, Ethan Hunt, returns and partners up with the beautiful Nyah Hall to stop renegade agent Sean Ambrose from releasing a new kind of terror on an unsuspecting world.

programme.title: 40 Dates and 40 Nights
programme.desc: Burned out on dating and ready to quit, Leah takes her eccentric grandma's outrageous challenge—40 dates in 40 nights for a full year of paid rent.

programme.title: Detective Story
programme.desc: Kirk Douglas stars as the rigid detective whose personal code has become twisted from dealing with too many criminals. Eleanor Parker is his wife, tormented by a guilty secret.

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: Frank Sinatra, Laurence Harvey, Janet Leigh, and Angela Lansbury headline an all-star cast in this daring thriller rife with political intrigue, mental manipulation, and a diabolical plot that may lead to the highest levels of the government.

programme.title: The Train
programme.desc: Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.

programme.title: Troy
programme.desc: Throughout time, men have waged war. Some for power, some for glory, some for honor ... and some for love.

programme.title: Fight Club
programme.desc: A detached man and his friend organize brutal, bare-knuckle boxing matches.

programme.title: Inglourious Basterds (2009)
programme.desc: An American officer is in charge of an all-Jewish squad known as The Basterds and is tasked with the mission of killing as many Nazi troops as possible.

programme.title: Hush
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: A Quiet Place Part II
programme.desc: Following the deadly events at home, the Abbott family (Emily Blunt, Millicent Simmonds, Noah Jupe) continues their fight for survival in silence, now facing the terrors of the outside world in this suspenseful thriller directed by John Krasinski.

programme.title: Sleepwalker
programme.desc: Haunted by terrifying visions, Sarah's sleepwalking episodes begin to intensify, accelerating her descent into darkness.

programme.title: Coming to America
programme.desc: Join EDDIE MURPHY on an unforgettable comic quest to the New World. As an African Prince, it's time for him to find a princess. The mission leads him and his most loyal friend (ARSENIO HALL) to New York. Watch Murphy and Hall in classic cameo roles!

programme.title: The Golden Child
programme.desc: As ‘The Chosen One’, Murphy’s on a madcap mission to save The Golden Child, a youth with mystical powers who’s been abducted by an evil cult.

programme.title: Norbit
programme.desc: Murphy stars as mild-mannered Norbit, who gets a second chance at love with his childhood sweetheart, Kate. However, obstacles may make this romance slightly more difficult than expected.

programme.title: Death Warrant
programme.desc: Action superstar Jean-Claude van Damme ("Bloodsport", "Cyborg") is a veteran undercover cop posing as an inmate in a dangerously corrupt state prison.

programme.title: Double Impact
programme.desc: Identical twins are separated at six months and raised on different continents. They reunite twenty-five years later to avenge the murder of their parents and reclaim their stolen family fortune.

programme.title: Double Team
programme.desc: Action superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme joins forces with NBA and media sensation Dennis Rodman in this action-packed thriller. Top counter-terrorist Jack Quinn is ready to get out of the spy game until the evil Stavros kidnaps his wife and unborn son.

programme.title: Superstar
programme.desc: All Mary Katherine Gallagher wants in life is a kiss. Not just any kiss, mind you – a Hollywood-style kiss. But no matter how hard she tries, no one will kiss her. She decides that to get her kiss, she must become just like the people in the movies.

programme.title: Three Amigos!
programme.desc: Steve Martin, Chevy Chase and Martin Short are three wild and crazy caballeros in this comedy adventure that’s a fiesta of fun. Co-starring Phil Hartman and Jon Lovitz, the '¡Three Amigos!' blaze a side-splitting trail across the comedy frontier!

programme.title: Wayne's World
programme.desc: When a sleazy TV exec offers Wayne and Garth a contract to tape their late-night cable-access show at his network, they discover the road to the big time is full of gnarly twists and turns.

programme.title: New Year's Eve
programme.desc: Set in New York on New Year's Eve, this romantic comedy celebrates love, hope, forgiveness, second chances, and fresh starts through the intertwining stories of couples and singles, told amid the pulse and promise of the most dazzling night of the year.

programme.title: The Notebook
programme.desc: In a tale of love lost and found again, two ordinary people are rendered extraordinary by the strength, power, and beauty of true love.

programme.title: Dirty Dancing
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey star in this spirit-lifting story about a summer love affair between a naïve 17-year-old girl and a charismatic dance instructor at a Catskills hotel. Rated PG-13

programme.title: Body of Lies
programme.desc: Leonardo Di Caprio and Academy Award winner Russell Crowe star in director Ridley Scott's adaptation of the best-selling post-9/11 espionage thriller.

programme.title: Man on Fire (2004)
programme.desc: A Marine swears vengeance on those who committed an act against the family he was hired to protect.

programme.title: Crimson Tide
programme.desc: The USS Alabama receives an unconfirmed order to launch its missiles.

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Clint Eastwood and Academy Award-winner Steven Spielberg comes the life stories of the six men who raised the flag at The Battle of Iwo Jima, a turning point in WWII.

programme.title: Any Given Sunday
programme.desc: Academy Award winner Al Pacino and Cameron Diaz lead a stellar cast in Oscar-winning Oliver Stone's hard-hitting homage to the gridiron gladiators of Any Given Sunday.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Dances With Wolves
programme.desc: After encountering and eventually being accepted by a Native American tribe, Dunbar's loyalties are put to the test when the army threatens his new home, forcing him to choose between white America or the natives he now calls his people.

programme.title: Geronimo: An American Legend
programme.desc: An American legend comes to life in this epic Western, starring Jason Patric, Robert Duvall, Gene Hackman, and Wes Studi as Geronimo, who delivers a stunning performance as the fearless warrior who was the last Indian leader to surrender to the white man.

programme.title: Houseboat

programme.title: I Know Where I'm Going!
programme.desc: A young Englishwoman goes to the Hebrides to marry her older, wealthier fiancé. When the weather keeps them separated on different islands, she begins to have second thoughts.

programme.title: A Canterbury Tale
programme.desc: Set amid the tumult of the Second World War, the film follows three modern-day incarnations of Chaucer’s pilgrims, who are forced to solve a bizarre village crime in the English countryside en route to the mythical town of Canterbury.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back and gain the freedom of his people in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Black Hawk Down
programme.desc: Based on the true story of a war waged in Mogadishu by the high-tech Black Hawk helicopters and the US Army Rangers and Deltas.

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Denzel Washington returns to one of his signature roles in the first sequel of his career. Robert McCall serves unflinching justice for the exploited and oppressed – but how far will he go when it is someone he loves?

programme.title: The Devil Inside
programme.desc: In 1989 Maria Rossi was diagnosed insane after brutally murdering three people. Twenty years later, her daughter Isabella searches for answers that lead to an exorcism of her mother.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: When four teenagers all meet with mysterious deaths exactly one week after watching a videotape, investigative reporter Rachel Keller tracks down the video... and watches it.

programme.title: Goodnight Mommy
programme.desc: In the heat of the summer. A lonesome house in the countryside between woods and cornfields. Nine-year-old twin brothers are waiting for their mother.

programme.title: Norbit
programme.desc: Murphy stars as mild-mannered Norbit, who gets a second chance at love with his childhood sweetheart, Kate. However, obstacles may make this romance slightly more difficult than expected.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea Goes to Jail
programme.desc: At long last, Madea returns to the big screen! This time, America's favorite irreverent, pistol-packin' grandmomma is raising hell behind bars and lobbying for her freedom.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Family Reunion
programme.desc: A pistol-packing grandma tries to hold a family reunion, a funeral, and a wedding all in the same weekend.

programme.title: Tekken: Kazuya's Revenge
programme.desc: A defenseless man is kidnapped by an organized crime syndicate and turned into a ruthless assassin.

programme.title: Lady Bloodfight
programme.desc: Upon arriving in Hong Kong, an American woman is beaten up and mugged by thugs. She's taken in by a martial arts master who trains her for a formidable fight competition known as the Kumite.

programme.title: Bloodsport
programme.desc: Ninjitsu master Frank Dux journeys to Hong Kong to enter the Kumite, the Olympics of martial arts, and meets a beautiful American reporter. Before long he must face Chong-Li, a vicious Korean master of Tae Kwan Do, in a climactic fight to the finish.

programme.title: Planes, Trains & Automobiles
programme.desc: Neal just wants to fly home to Chicago for Thanksgiving with his family. But all he gets is misery. Misery named Del Griffith, a loud-mouthed salesman who leads Neal on a wild goose chase.

programme.title: Armed and Dangerous (1986)
programme.desc: John Candy and Eugene Levy charge into the world of private security in the outrageous action-comedy ARMED AND DANGEROUS. Unfortunately, they're usually charging in the wrong direction! Rating: PG-13

programme.title: The Nutty Professor (1996)
programme.desc: Eddie Murphy gives "the performances" of his career -- playing seven roles! -- in this hilarious comedy about a genetics professor who experiments with his own fat-reducing serum.

programme.title: Chef
programme.desc: Chef quits his job in LA after refusing to compromise with its owner; he is left to figure out what's next. He teams up with his ex, a friend & his son to launch a food truck, reigniting his passion for the kitchen and zest for life.

programme.title: Father of the Bride
programme.desc: Steve Martin turns in a heartwarming and hilarious performance.

programme.title: The Bounty Hunter (2010)
programme.desc: Milo is a bounty hunter who gets his dream job when he is assigned to track down his bail-jumping reporter ex-wife. When she gives him the slip so she can chase a lead on a murder cover-up, Milo realizes that nothing ever goes smoothly with her.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: Thunderheart
programme.desc: Val Kilmer, Sam Shepard, and Graham Greene star in this murder mystery filled with style and suspense. Kilmer stars as Ray Levoi, a hotshot FBI agent who's thrust into a strange new world when he is sent to solve a murder on an Indian reservation.

programme.title: Vertical Limit
programme.desc: An emotionally charged action-adventure tale of a retired climber (O'Donnell) who must launch a treacherous and extraordinary rescue effort up K2, the world's second-highest peak, to save his estranged sister and her summit team in a race against time.

programme.title: Remember
programme.desc: Everything is not what it seems in this riveting revenge thriller, where a relentless man will stop at nothing to find and kill the Nazi officer who murdered his family 70 years earlier in WWII.

programme.title: A Soldier's Story
programme.desc: A fine drama set during World War II, in which a black military attorney investigates the death of a black sergeant. The lawyer eventually discovers that the sergeant was both ashamed of his own culture and virulently hated by his men.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Winner of 2 Academy Awards, including Best Original Screenplay. With the help of his mentor, a slave-turned-bounty hunter sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal plantation owner.

programme.title: The Hateful Eight
programme.desc: Quentin Tarantino’s 8th film takes place in wintry Wyoming, where eight strangers, including two bounty hunters and a wanted fugitive, find themselves battling the elements and each other.

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

programme.title: Small Soldiers
programme.desc: Joe Dante directed this satirical action-comedy about talking tech toys accidentally juiced-up with military microchips.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (2014)
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Sex. Money. Power. Drugs. Brace yourself for a true story from legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese. Leonardo DiCaprio stars as a young stockbroker hungry for a life of non-stop thrills, where corruption was king and more was never enough.

programme.title: GoodFellas
programme.desc: Director Martin Scorsese exposes the fascinating, mysterious, and violent underworld of New York's Mafia families through the life of insider Henry Hill.

programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five friends are holed up in a remote cabin, where they discover a Book Of The Dead. They unwittingly summon demons living in the nearby woods, which in turn possess the youngsters until only one remains intact to fight for survival.

programme.title: The Haunting
programme.desc: In this edge-of-your-seat supernatural thriller featuring Hollywood's hottest stars, a study in fear escalates into a heart-stopping nightmare for a professor and three subjects trapped in a mysterious mansion.

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
programme.desc: Master of horror Wes Craven presents a sexy, modern-day adaptation of the classic Gothic thriller. After Dracula is awakened from his 100-year slumber, he makes America his first destination, specifically the exotic city of New Orleans.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and, therefore, all youthful joy have been banned.

programme.title: St. Elmo's Fire
programme.desc: Seven friends, recent college graduates, are searching for a place in the real world as they face issues of career and commitment. Rating: R

programme.title: Next of Kin
programme.desc: When the mob murders policeman Truman Gates' younger brother, Gates is torn between his desire to uphold the law and his lust for revenge. But Gates' older brother will not be satisfied until every member of the Chicago mob is dead.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin' Rydell High for a whole new term! It's 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there's a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: A star bowler whose career was prematurely "cut off" hopes to ride a new prodigy to success and riches.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America, along with the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: Winners of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which the irresistible stolen loot from a crime scene sets off an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: Inside Llewyn Davis
programme.desc: Inside Llewyn Davis follows a young folk singer as he navigates the Greenwich Village folk scene of 1961. Llewyn Davis (Oscar Isaac) is struggling to make it as a musician against seemling insurmountable obstacles - some of them of his own making.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: Winners of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which the irresistible stolen loot from a crime scene sets off an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Multiple Academy Award winner Tom Hanks reunites with his Sleepless in Seattle co-star, Meg Ryan, and director Nora Ephron, to discover love at first byte in this online romantic comedy.

programme.title: City Slickers
programme.desc: Billy Crystal and Jack Palance ride the range as a middle-aged urban SUV jockey and a hardened and weathered cowpoke in this Western tale of a cattle drive that becomes a journey of self-discovery for a band of City Slickers.

programme.title: The First Wives Club
programme.desc: Join the Club - The First Wives Club, the good-time battle-of-the-sexes satire sparked by snappy one-liners, great physical-comedy gags, and three unforgettable stars in top form, Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, and Diane Keaton.

programme.title: The Exorcist
programme.desc: When a charming 12-year-old girl takes on the characteristics and voices of others, the girl's mother realizes the devil has possessed her daughter—and that her daughter's only hope lies with two priests and the ancient rite of demonic exorcism.

programme.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
programme.desc: This dazzling remake of the 1956 spine-tingler stars Donald Sutherland, Brooke Adams, Jeff Goldblum, Leonard Nimoy and Veronica Cartwright in an eerie tale of possession by "alien pods."

programme.title: Futureworld
